                  ? 'bg-amber-500 border-amber-600 text-white shadow-xs'
                  : 'border-gray-300 bg-white text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50'
              }`}
            >
              <span className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${criticalPathOn ? 'bg-white' : 'bg-gray-400'}`} />
              Critical path
            </button>

            {/* Baseline (Story 5) */}
            <button
              onClick={() => setBaselineModalOpen(true)}
              className={`outline-none font-semibold rounded-lg border px-3 py-1.5 2xl:text-sm 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs transition-colors flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
                showBaseline
                  ? 'bg-indigo-600 border-indigo-700 text-white shadow-xs'
                  : 'border-gray-300 bg-white text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50'
              }`}
            >
              <span>Baseline</span>
              {showBaseline && <span className="bg-white/20 text-white rounded px-1 text-[10px]">ON</span>}
            </button>

            {/* Unscheduled (Story 4) */}
            <button
              onClick={() => setUnscheduledOpen(true)}
              className="outline-none font-semibold rounded-lg border border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 hover:bg-indigo-100 2xl:text-sm 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs px-3 py-1.5 flex items-center gap-1.5"
            >
              <span>Unscheduled</span>
              <span className="bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-full px-1.5 py-0.2 text-[10px] font-bold">
                {unscheduledCount}
              </span>
            </button>

            <div className="h-5 w-px bg-gray-200" />

            {/* Share dropdown (Story 6) */}
            <div className="relative">
              <button
                onClick={() => setShareMenuOpen(prev => !prev)}
                className="outline-none font-semibold rounded-lg border border-transparent bg-indigo-600 text-white hover:opacity-90 2xl:text-sm 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs px-3 py-1.5 flex items-center gap-1.5"
              >
                <span className="icon-share-07 text-sm" />
                Share
                <span className="icon-chevron-down text-xs ml-0.5" />
              </button>

              {shareMenuOpen && (
                <div className="absolute right-0 mt-1 w-44 bg-white rounded-lg shadow-lg border border-gray-200 py-1 z-40">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => { setShareMenuOpen(false); handleExportPDF() }}
                    className="w-full text-left px-3 py-2 text-xs text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-100 flex items-center gap-2"
                  >
                    <span className="icon-download-02 text-xs text-gray-500" />
                    Export PDF
                  </button>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => { setShareMenuOpen(false); setShareModalOpen(true) }}
                    className="w-full text-left px-3 py-2 text-xs text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-100 flex items-center gap-2"
                  >
                    <span className="icon-link-01 text-xs text-gray-500" />
                    Client view link
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* ── Gantt Body: Left Grid + Calendar ─────────────────────────── */}
          <div className="flex flex-1 overflow-hidden relative" ref={calAreaRef}>

            {/* Left Grid */}
            <div className="flex-shrink-0 border-r border-gray-200 overflow-y-auto overflow-x-hidden bg-white" style={{ width: dynamicGridW }}>
              {/* Day Header row alignment */}
              <div className="flex items-center bg-gray-50 border-b border-gray-200 sticky top-0 z-20 h-[40px]">
                {dynamicCols.map(col => (
                  <div
                    key={col.key}
                    className="2xl:text-xs 2xl-to-xl:text-[11px] text-[11px] text-gray-500 font-semibold px-2 shrink-0 truncate flex items-center"
                    style={{ width: col.w }}
                  >
                    {col.label}
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>

              {/* Pinned Milestones Row in Grid (Story 3 — Fixed Cost only) */}
              {projectModel === 'Fixed Cost' && (
                <div className="flex items-center px-3 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50/70 font-semibold text-xs text-gray-700 sticky top-[40px] z-10" style={{ height: ROW_H }}>
                  <span className="icon-flag-01 text-gray-400 mr-2 text-sm" />
                  Milestones ({GANTT_MILESTONES.length})
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Pinned Sprints Row in Grid (Story 3) */}
              <div
                className="flex items-center px-3 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50/70 font-semibold text-xs text-gray-700 sticky z-10"
                style={{ height: ROW_H, top: projectModel === 'Fixed Cost' ? 80 : 40 }}
              >
                <span className="icon-calendar-check-02 text-gray-400 mr-2 text-sm" />
                Sprints ({GANTT_SPRINTS.length})
              </div>

              {/* Issue & Developer Rows (Story 2 & Story 7) */}
              {rows.map(issue => {
                if (issue.isGroupHeader) {
                  return (
                    <div
                      key={issue.id}
                      className="flex items-center px-3 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50/90 font-semibold text-xs text-gray-800"
                      style={{ height: ROW_H }}
                    >
                      <div className="w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-700 font-bold text-[10px] flex items-center justify-center mr-2 shrink-0">
                        {issue.groupTitle.split(' ').map(n => n[0]).join('')}
                      </div>
                      <span className="truncate font-bold text-gray-900">{issue.groupTitle}</span>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 ml-1.5 font-normal">({issue.role})</span>
                      {issue.hasClash && (
                        <span className="ml-auto px-1.5 py-0.2 bg-red-100 text-red-700 text-[9px] font-bold rounded">
                          ⚠️ Clashing
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  )
                }

                return (
                  <div
                    key={issue.id}
                    className="flex items-center border-b border-gray-100 hover:bg-indigo-50/40 cursor-pointer"
                    style={{ height: ROW_H }}
                    onClick={() => {
                      setUnscheduledOpen(false)
                      setCreateModalOpen(false)
                      setCompanyGanttOpen(false)
                      setResourcePlannerOpen(false)
                      setPanel(issue)
                    }}
                  >
                    {dynamicCols.map(col => {
                      if (col.key === 'type') {
                        return (
                          <div key="type" className="shrink-0 flex items-center px-2" style={{ width: col.w, paddingLeft: issue.depth ? 16 : 8 }}>
                            {issue.issue_type === 'Epic' && (
                              <button
                                className="icon-chevron-right text-gray-400 text-xs mr-1 hover:text-indigo-600 transition-transform"
                                style={{ transform: collapsed[issue.id] ? 'rotate(0deg)' : 'rotate(90deg)' }}
                                onClick={e => { e.stopPropagation(); setCollapsed(c => ({ ...c, [issue.id]: !c[issue.id] })) }}
                              />
                            )}
                            {issue.depth > 0 && <span className="icon-corner-down-right text-gray-300 text-xs mr-1" />}
                            <TypeIcon type={issue.issue_type} />
                          </div>
                        )
                      }
                      if (col.key === 'board') {
                        return (
                          <div key="board" className="px-1 shrink-0 truncate flex items-center" style={{ width: col.w }}>
                            <span className={`text-[9px] font-semibold px-1 py-0.2 rounded border ${
                              issue.board === 'Test' ? 'bg-purple-50 text-purple-700 border-purple-200' : 'bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 border-indigo-200'
                            }`}>
                              {issue.board || 'Default'}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        )
                      }
                      if (col.key === 'key') {
                        return (
                          <div key="key" className="2xl:text-xs 2xl-to-xl:text-[11px] text-[11px] font-medium text-indigo-700 hover:underline shrink-0 truncate px-1" style={{ width: col.w }}>
                            {issue.key}
                          </div>
                        )
                      }
                      if (col.key === 'title') {
                        return (
                          <div key="title" className="2xl:text-xs 2xl-to-xl:text-[11px] text-[11px] text-gray-700 shrink-0 truncate px-1 font-medium" style={{ width: col.w }}>
                            {issue.title}
                          </div>
                        )
                      }
                      if (col.key === 'assignee') {
                        return (
                          <div key="assignee" className="2xl:text-xs 2xl-to-xl:text-[11px] text-[11px] text-gray-500 shrink-0 truncate px-1" style={{ width: col.w }}>
                            {issue.assignee_name}
                          </div>
                        )
                      }
                      if (col.key === 'start_date' || col.key === 'start') {
                        return (
                          <div key="start_date" className="2xl:text-xs 2xl-to-xl:text-[11px] text-[11px] text-gray-500 shrink-0 truncate px-1" style={{ width: col.w }}>
                            {issue.start_date || '—'}
                          </div>
                        )
                      }
                      if (col.key === 'due_date' || col.key === 'due') {
                        return (
                          <div key="due_date" className={`2xl:text-xs 2xl-to-xl:text-[11px] text-[11px] shrink-0 truncate px-1 ${isPastDue(issue) ? 'text-red-600 font-semibold' : 'text-gray-500'}`} style={{ width: col.w }}>
                            {issue.due_date || '—'}
                          </div>
                        )
                      }
                      return null
                    })}
                  </div>
                )
              })}
            </div>

            {/* Calendar Canvas */}
            <div className="flex-1 overflow-x-auto overflow-y-auto relative bg-white" ref={calScrollRef}>
              <div style={{ width: Math.max(calendarWidth, 800), minHeight: '100%', position: 'relative' }}>

                {/* Calendar Timeline Header (2-tier: Months + Days/Weeks) */}
                <div className="bg-gray-50 border-b border-gray-200 sticky top-0 z-20 h-[40px] flex flex-col">
                  {/* Top Tier: Month Groups */}
                  <div className="flex border-b border-gray-200 h-[20px]">
                    {monthGroups.map((mg, idx) => (
                      <div
                        key={idx}
                        className="shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center border-r border-gray-200 text-[11px] font-semibold text-gray-700 bg-gray-100/70"
                        style={{ width: mg.count * cellW, height: 20 }}
                      >
                        {mg.key}
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>

                  {/* Bottom Tier: Days or Weeks */}
                  <div className="flex h-[20px]">
                    {viewMode === 'Quarter' ? (
                      weekGroups.map((wg, idx) => (
                        <div
                          key={idx}
                          className="shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center border-r border-gray-200 text-[10px] font-medium text-gray-500 bg-gray-50"
                          style={{ width: wg.count * cellW, height: 20 }}
                        >
                          {wg.label}
                        </div>
                      ))
                    ) : (
                      days.map((d, i) => (
                        <div
                          key={i}
                          className={`shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center border-r border-gray-100 text-[10px] font-medium ${
                            isWeekend(d) ? 'text-gray-400 bg-gray-50' : 'text-gray-600'
                          } ${d.toDateString() === TODAY.toDateString() ? 'text-indigo-600 font-bold bg-indigo-50/50' : ''}`}
                          style={{ width: cellW, height: 20 }}
                        >
                          {viewMode === 'Week' ? `${d.getDate()} ${['Su','Mo','Tu','We','Th','Fr','Sa'][d.getDay()]}` : d.getDate()}
                        </div>
                      ))
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Pinned Milestones Row on Canvas (Story 3 — Fixed Cost only) */}
                {projectModel === 'Fixed Cost' && (
                  <div className="relative flex border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50/40 sticky top-[40px] z-10" style={{ height: ROW_H }}>
                    {days.map((d, i) => (
                      <div
                        key={i}
                        className={`shrink-0 border-r border-gray-100 ${isWeekend(d) ? 'bg-gray-50/50' : ''}`}
                        style={{ width: cellW, height: ROW_H }}
                      />
                    ))}
                    {GANTT_MILESTONES.map(m => {
                      const mDate = parseDate(m.date)
                      if (!mDate) return null
                      const left = dayDiff(viewStart, mDate) * cellW
                      return (
                        <div
                          key={m.id}
                          className="absolute top-[8px] h-[24px] rounded-full px-2.5 flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-xs cursor-pointer text-white text-[10px] font-semibold"
                          style={{ left, backgroundColor: m.color }}
                          title={`${m.name} (${m.status}) - ${m.date}`}
                        >
                          <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-white" />
                          <span className="truncate">{m.name}</span>
                        </div>
                      )
                    })}
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Pinned Sprints Row on Canvas (Story 3) */}
                <div
                  className="relative flex border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50/40 sticky z-10"
                  style={{ height: ROW_H, top: projectModel === 'Fixed Cost' ? 80 : 40 }}
                >
                  {days.map((d, i) => (
                    <div
                      key={i}
                      className={`shrink-0 border-r border-gray-100 ${isWeekend(d) ? 'bg-gray-50/50' : ''}`}
                      style={{ width: cellW, height: ROW_H }}
                    />
                  ))}
                  {GANTT_SPRINTS.map(s => {
                    const sStart = parseDate(s.start)
                    const sEnd   = parseDate(s.end)
                    if (!sStart || !sEnd) return null
                    const left  = dayDiff(viewStart, sStart) * cellW
                    const width = (dayDiff(sStart, sEnd) + 1) * cellW
                    return (
                      <div
                        key={s.id}
                        className="absolute top-[8px] h-[24px] rounded-lg border border-indigo-300 bg-indigo-50/80 px-2 flex items-center justify-between text-indigo-700 text-[10px] font-semibold shadow-2xs"
                        style={{ left, width }}
                      >
                        <span className="truncate">{s.name}</span>
                        <span className="text-[9px] text-indigo-500 font-normal">{s.start} – {s.end}</span>
                      </div>
                    )
                  })}
                </div>

                {/* SVG Dependency Lines Layer (Story 5) */}
                <svg
                  className="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none z-10"
                  style={{ width: Math.max(calendarWidth, 800), height: (rows.length + 2) * ROW_H + 40 }}
                >
                  <defs>
                    <marker id="arrow-norm" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" refX="5" refY="3" orient="auto">
                      <path d="M0,0 L6,3 L0,6 Z" fill="#6366f1" />
                    </marker>
                    <marker id="arrow-conf" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" refX="5" refY="3" orient="auto">
                      <path d="M0,0 L6,3 L0,6 Z" fill="#ef4444" />
                    </marker>
                    <marker id="arrow-crit" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" refX="5" refY="3" orient="auto">
                      <path d="M0,0 L6,3 L0,6 Z" fill="#f59e0b" />
                    </marker>
                  </defs>

                  {dependencyLines.map(l => {
                    const midX = l.x1 + 12
                    const path = `M ${l.x1} ${l.y1} L ${midX} ${l.y1} L ${midX} ${l.y2} L ${l.x2} ${l.y2}`
                    const strokeColor = l.conflict ? '#ef4444' : l.isCritical ? '#f59e0b' : '#6366f1'
                    const marker = l.conflict ? 'url(#arrow-conf)' : l.isCritical ? 'url(#arrow-crit)' : 'url(#arrow-norm)'

                    return (
                      <path
                        key={l.id}
                        d={path}
                        fill="none"
                        stroke={strokeColor}
                        strokeWidth={l.isCritical ? '2.5' : '1.5'}
                        strokeDasharray={l.conflict ? '4 2' : 'none'}
                        markerEnd={marker}
                      />
                    )
                  })}
                </svg>

                {/* Issue & Developer Rows on Canvas (Story 2 & Story 7) */}
                {rows.map((issue) => {
                  if (issue.isGroupHeader) {
                    const cStart = parseDate(issue.contract_start)
                    const cEnd   = parseDate(issue.contract_end)
                    const bLeft  = cStart ? dayDiff(viewStart, cStart) * cellW : 0
                    const bWidth = (cStart && cEnd) ? (dayDiff(cStart, cEnd) + 1) * cellW : 0

                    return (
                      <div key={issue.id} className="relative flex bg-gray-50/50" style={{ height: ROW_H }}>
                        {days.map((d, i) => (
                          <div
                            key={i}
                            className="shrink-0 border-r border-b border-gray-200/60"
                            style={{ width: cellW, height: ROW_H }}
                          />
                        ))}

                        {/* Contract Duration Band (Story 7) */}
                        {bWidth > 0 && (
                          <div
                            className="absolute top-[6px] h-[26px] bg-indigo-50 border border-indigo-200 rounded flex items-center px-2.5 z-5 shadow-2xs"
                            style={{ left: bLeft, width: bWidth }}
                          >
                            <span className="text-indigo-800 text-[10px] font-semibold truncate flex items-center gap-1.5">
                              <span className="icon-calendar text-indigo-600 text-xs" />
                              Contract: {issue.contract_start} – {issue.contract_end} ({issue.remaining_days} days left)
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        )}

                        {/* Double-booking warning band if clashing (Story 7) */}
                        {issue.hasClash && (() => {
                          const oStart = parseDate('05-Nov-2026')
                          const oEnd   = parseDate('12-Nov-2026')
                          if (!oStart || !oEnd) return null
                          const oLeft  = dayDiff(viewStart, oStart) * cellW
                          const oWidth = (dayDiff(oStart, oEnd) + 1) * cellW
                          return (
                            <div
                              className="absolute top-[4px] h-[30px] bg-red-100/95 border-2 border-dashed border-red-500 rounded z-20 flex items-center justify-between px-2 shadow-xs"
                              style={{ left: oLeft, width: oWidth }}
                              title="Double-booking conflict: Developer allocated on Apex E-Commerce for these dates"
                            >
                              <span className="text-red-800 text-[10px] font-bold truncate flex items-center gap-1">
                                <span className="icon-alert-triangle text-red-600 text-xs" />
                                ⚠️ Double-booked (Apex E-Commerce)
                              </span>
                              <button
                                onClick={() => setResourcePlannerOpen(true)}
                                className="ml-2 px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 text-white rounded text-[9px] font-bold whitespace-nowrap shadow-xs"
                              >
                                Resolve
                              </button>
                            </div>
                          )
                        })()}
                      </div>
                    )
                  }

                  const start = parseDate(issue.start_date)
                  const due   = parseDate(issue.due_date)
                  const hasDates = !!(start && due)
                  const sprint = issue.sprint_id ? GANTT_SPRINTS.find(s => s.id === issue.sprint_id) : null
                  const sprintStart = sprint ? parseDate(sprint.start) : null
                  const sprintEnd   = sprint ? parseDate(sprint.end) : null
                  const isCrit = criticalPathOn && criticalKeys.has(issue.id)
                  const baseEntry = baselineData[issue.id]

                  return (
                    <div key={issue.id} className="relative flex" style={{ height: ROW_H }}>
                      {days.map((d, i) => (
                        <div
                          key={i}
                          className={`shrink-0 border-r border-b border-gray-100 ${isWeekend(d) ? 'bg-gray-50/50' : 'hover:bg-indigo-50/40'}`}
                          style={{ width: cellW, height: ROW_H }}
                        />
                      ))}

                      {/* Baseline Plan Faint Bar (Story 5) */}
                      {showBaseline && baseEntry && (() => {
                        const bStart = parseDate(baseEntry.start)
                        const bDue   = parseDate(baseEntry.due)
                        if (!bStart || !bDue) return null
                        const bLeft  = dayDiff(viewStart, bStart) * cellW
                        const bWidth = Math.max((dayDiff(bStart, bDue) + 1) * cellW, cellW)
                        return (
                          <div
                            className="absolute top-[28px] h-[7px] rounded-sm bg-gray-400/50 border border-gray-500/40 pointer-events-none"
                            style={{ left: bLeft, width: bWidth }}
                            title={`Baseline: ${baseEntry.start} – ${baseEntry.due}`}
                          />
                        )
                      })()}

                      {/* Scheduled Bar */}
                      {hasDates && (() => {
                        const left = dayDiff(viewStart, start) * cellW
                        const width = Math.max((dayDiff(start, due) + 1) * cellW, cellW)
                        const color = STATUS_COLORS[issue.status] || '#696969'
                        const pastDue = isPastDue(issue)

                        return (
                          <div
                            className={`absolute top-[7px] h-[24px] rounded group shadow-sm flex items-center cursor-move transition-shadow ${
                              isCrit ? 'ring-2 ring-amber-400 ring-offset-1 border-amber-500' : ''
                            }`}
                            style={{
                              left,
                              width,
                              backgroundColor: color,
                              border: pastDue ? '2px solid #E23333' : isCrit ? '2px solid #f59e0b' : '1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.1)',
                              outline: pastDue ? '1px dashed #E23333' : 'none',
                            }}
                            onMouseDown={e => handleMouseDown(e, issue, 'move')}
                            onMouseEnter={e => {
                              const rect = calAreaRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect()
                              if (rect) setHovered({ issue, x: e.clientX - rect.left, y: e.clientY - rect.top, baseline: baseEntry })
                            }}
                            onMouseLeave={() => setHovered(null)}
                            onClick={() => setPanel(issue)}
                          >
                            <div
                              className="absolute left-0 top-0 bottom-0 w-2 cursor-ew-resize opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 bg-black/20 hover:bg-black/40 rounded-l"
                              title="Drag to change Start Date"
                              onMouseDown={e => handleMouseDown(e, issue, 'resize-left')}
                            />

                            <span className="text-white text-[10px] font-semibold truncate px-2 select-none pointer-events-none flex items-center gap-1">
                              {isCrit && <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-amber-300" />}
                              {issue.key}
                            </span>

                            <div
                              className="absolute right-0 top-0 bottom-0 w-2 cursor-ew-resize opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 bg-black/20 hover:bg-black/40 rounded-r"
                              title="Drag to change Due Date"
                              onMouseDown={e => handleMouseDown(e, issue, 'resize-right')}
                            />
                          </div>
                        )
                      })()}

                      {/* Sprint-only bar */}
                      {!hasDates && sprint && sprintStart && sprintEnd && (() => {
                        const left = dayDiff(viewStart, sprintStart) * cellW
                        const width = Math.max((dayDiff(sprintStart, sprintEnd) + 1) * cellW, cellW)
                        return (
                          <div
                            className="absolute top-[7px] h-[24px] rounded border border-dashed border-indigo-300 bg-indigo-50/70 flex items-center px-2 cursor-pointer shadow-none"
                            style={{ left, width }}
                            title={`${sprint.name} span (no dates set)`}
                            onClick={() => setPanel(issue)}
                          >
                            <span className="text-indigo-600 text-[10px] font-medium truncate select-none">
                              {issue.key} ({sprint.name})
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        )
                      })()}

                      {/* Past-due dashed extension to today line */}
                      {hasDates && isPastDue(issue) && (() => {
                        const dueLeft = dayDiff(viewStart, due) * cellW + cellW
                        if (todayOffset <= dueLeft) return null
                        return (
                          <div
                            className="absolute top-[19px] border-t-2 border-dashed border-red-500 pointer-events-none"
                            style={{ left: dueLeft, width: todayOffset - dueLeft }}
                          />
                        )
                      })()}
                    </div>
                  )
                })}

                {/* Expiry Date Marker Line (Story 3 - Hourly Project) */}
                {projectModel === 'Hourly' && (() => {
                  const expDate = parseDate(GANTT_PROJECT.expiry_date)
                  if (!expDate) return null
                  const expLeft = dayDiff(viewStart, expDate) * cellW
                  return (
                    <div
                      className="absolute top-0 bottom-0 border-l-2 border-dashed border-amber-500 z-15 pointer-events-none"
                      style={{ left: expLeft }}
                    >
                      <div className="bg-amber-500 text-white text-[9px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded -ml-6 mt-1 shadow-xs whitespace-nowrap">
                        Expiry Date: {GANTT_PROJECT.expiry_date}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )
                })()}

                {/* Contract Dates Band (Story 3 - Hire Base Project) */}
                {projectModel === 'Hire Base' && (() => {
                  const cStart = parseDate('01-Nov-2026')
                  const cEnd   = parseDate('28-Nov-2026')
                  if (!cStart || !cEnd) return null
                  const bLeft  = dayDiff(viewStart, cStart) * cellW
                  const bWidth = (dayDiff(cStart, cEnd) + 1) * cellW
                  return (
                    <div
                      className="absolute top-[40px] bottom-0 bg-blue-500/5 border-x-2 border-blue-400/40 pointer-events-none z-5"
                      style={{ left: bLeft, width: bWidth }}
                    >
                      <div className="bg-blue-600 text-white text-[9px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded m-2 inline-block">
                        Hire Base Contract (8 days left)
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )
                })()}

                {/* Today Line */}
                {todayOffset >= 0 && todayOffset <= calendarWidth && (
                  <div
                    className="absolute top-0 bottom-0 w-[2px] bg-indigo-500 z-20 pointer-events-none"
                    style={{ left: todayOffset }}
                  >
                    <div className="w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-indigo-500 -ml-[5px] -mt-1 shadow-sm" />
                  </div>
                )}

              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Hover card */}
            {hovered && <HoverCard issue={hovered.issue} x={hovered.x} y={hovered.y} baseline={hovered.baseline} />}

            {/* Issue Detail Panel */}
            {panel && (
              <IssueDetailPanel
                issue={issues.find(i => i.id === panel.id) || panel}
                onClose={() => setPanel(null)}
                onUpdateDates={handlePanelUpdateDates}
              />
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Unscheduled Issues Drawer (Story 4) */}
      <UnscheduledDrawer
        open={unscheduledOpen}
        onClose={() => setUnscheduledOpen(false)}
        issues={issues}
        onSchedule={handleScheduleFromUnscheduled}
      />

      {/* Create Issue Modal (Story 1 & Real CollabCRM popup modal) */}
      <CreateIssueModal
        open={createModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setCreateModalOpen(false)}
        onCreate={handleCreateIssue}
      />

      {/* Baseline Modal (Story 5) */}
      <BaselineModal
        open={baselineModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setBaselineModalOpen(false)}
        onSave={handleSaveBaseline}
        showBaseline={showBaseline}
        onToggleShow={setShowBaseline}
      />

      {/* Share Modal (Story 6) */}
      <ShareModal
        open={shareModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setShareModalOpen(false)}
        isClientLinkActive={isClientLinkActive}
        onToggleClientLink={setIsClientLinkActive}
        onOpenClientView={() => setClientMode(true)}
      />

      {/* Resource Planner Drawer (Story 7) */}
      <ResourcePlannerDrawer
        open={resourcePlannerOpen}
        onClose={() => setResourcePlannerOpen(false)}
        doubleBookingActive={doubleBookingActive}
        onResolveClash={() => {
          setDoubleBookingActive(false)
          setResourcePlannerOpen(false)
        }}
      />

      {/* Company Projects Dashboard Gantt (Story 8) */}
      <CompanyDashboardModal
        open={companyGanttOpen}
        onClose={() => setCompanyGanttOpen(false)}
        onSelectProject={(p) => {
          if (p === 'Mobile App Dedicated Team') {
            setProjectModel('Hire Base')
            setGroupBy('Assignee')
          }
        }}
      />

      {/* Undo Toast */}
      <UndoToast
        visible={undoToast}
        onUndo={handleUndo}
        onDismiss={() => setUndoToast(false)}
      />
    </AppShell>
  )
}


=== FILE: src/pages/Patterns.jsx ===
// KIT: every UI pattern variant seen in CollabCRM, rendered from verbatim DOM (src/data/patterns.js, generated by _tools/kit_patterns.py). Route /patterns?tab=…
// DIVERGES: KIT-only page (the card + caption around each snippet are not a CollabCRM screen). Caption class = CAP in components/super/ui.jsx.
import { useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom'
import AppShell from '../components/AppShell.jsx'
import PageFrame from '../components/cc/PageFrame.jsx'
import PillTabs from '../components/cc/PillTabs.jsx'
import { CAP, CARD } from '../components/super/ui.jsx'
import { PEOPLE_NAV } from '../data/nav.js'
import PATTERNS from '../data/patterns.js'

export default function Patterns() {
  const names = Object.keys(PATTERNS)
  const [qs, setQs] = useSearchParams()
  const tab = names.includes(qs.get('tab')) ? qs.get('tab') : names[0]
  return (
    <AppShell portal="people" nav={PEOPLE_NAV} active="">
      <PageFrame crumbs={[{ label: 'Patterns' }]}>
        <PillTabs tabs={names.map((n) => ({ key: n, label: `${n} (${PATTERNS[n].length})` }))} active={tab} onChange={(k) => setQs({ tab: k })} />
        <div className="grid gap-3 pt-4">
          {PATTERNS[tab].map((v, i) => (
            <div key={i} className={`${CARD} p-4`}>
              <p className={CAP}>Variant {i + 1} · seen {v.count}× · copy from {v.source}</p>
              <div className="pt-3 overflow-x-auto" dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: v.snippet }} />
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </PageFrame>
    </AppShell>
  )
}

// KIT: every CollabCRM portal shell with its real sidebar. Routes: / (index) and /portal/:slug.
// Sidebars: src/data/portal_nav.js (generated from the crawl by _tools/extract_nav.py) + PEOPLE_NAV (nav.js).
// DIVERGES: KIT-only index list (not a CollabCRM screen). Link class = TLINK in components/super/ui.jsx.
import { Link, useParams } from 'react-router-dom'
import AppShell from '../components/AppShell.jsx'
import PageFrame from '../components/cc/PageFrame.jsx'
import { PEOPLE_NAV, RECRUITMENT_NAV, REPORTS_NAV, PAYROLL_NAV, CRM_NAV } from '../data/nav.js'
import { PORTAL_NAV } from '../data/portal_nav.js'
import { TLINK } from '../components/super/ui.jsx'
import DemoMenu from '../components/demo/DemoMenu.jsx'
import Pin from '../components/demo/Pin.jsx'

export const PORTALS = [['people', 'People'], ['sales-crm', 'CRM & Invoice'], ['project-management', 'Project Management'], ['recruitment', 'Recruitment'], ['reports', 'Reports'], ['payroll', 'Payroll'], ['administration', 'Administration']]
const OWN_NAV = { people: PEOPLE_NAV, recruitment: RECRUITMENT_NAV, reports: REPORTS_NAV, payroll: PAYROLL_NAV, 'sales-crm': CRM_NAV }
const navOf = (slug) => OWN_NAV[slug] || PORTAL_NAV[slug]?.items || []

export function PortalPage() {
  const { slug } = useParams()
  const name = PORTALS.find(([s]) => s === slug)?.[1] || slug
  return (
    <AppShell portal={slug} nav={navOf(slug)} active="Dashboard" topRight={<DemoMenu />}>
      <PageFrame crumbs={[{ label: name }]}>
        <p className="2xl:text-sm 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs text-gray-600">Sidebar source: {slug === 'people' ? 'src/data/nav.js PEOPLE_NAV' : PORTAL_NAV[slug]?.source}</p>
      </PageFrame>
    </AppShell>
  )
}

export default function Portals() {
  const links = [...PORTALS.map(([s, n]) => [`/portal/${s}`, `${n} shell`]), ['/super', 'Super Admin shell'], ['/patterns', 'Every UI pattern variant in CollabCRM'], ['/components', 'Kit components']]
  return (
    <AppShell portal="people" nav={PEOPLE_NAV} active="Dashboard" topRight={<DemoMenu />}>
      <PageFrame crumbs={[{ label: 'CollabCRM prototype kit' }]}>
        <Pin s="K1" n={1} />
        <div className="grid gap-3">{links.map(([to, label]) => <Link key={to} to={to} className={TLINK}>{label}</Link>)}</div>
      </PageFrame>
    </AppShell>
  )
}

=== FILE: src/pages/check/CheckBreadcrumb.jsx ===
// /check/breadcrumb (19 Nov 2026): every breadcrumb group — the live captured <nav> beside the kit output (LiveBreadcrumb),
// plus the live hover / default rows measured on staging. kitshots.cjs in _graph/jobs/breadcrumb-2026-11-19 compares
// element by element and re-measures the kit in-state (hover) for the style compare.
import { LiveBreadcrumb, BREADCRUMB_GROUPS } from '../../components/Breadcrumbs.jsx'
import { BCL, BC_STATE_ROWS } from '../../data/breadcrumbLive.js'

export default function CheckBreadcrumb() {
  const live = [...new Set(BC_STATE_ROWS.map((r) => r.group))]
  return (
    <div className="p-6 bg-gray-50 min-h-screen">
      <h1 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900 mb-1">Breadcrumb: live capture vs kit</h1>
      <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mb-4">{BREADCRUMB_GROUPS.length} groups · {BC_STATE_ROWS.length} live state rows</p>
      <section className="mb-8">
        {BREADCRUMB_GROUPS.map((gid) => (
          <div key={gid} className="border-b border-gray-200 py-3">
            <div className="text-xs text-gray-600 mb-1">{gid} · {BCL[gid].captures} captures · {BCL[gid].portals.join(', ')} · {BCL[gid].src.split('/').pop()}</div>
            <div className="text-[10px] text-gray-400">live</div>
            <div data-cell={`g__${gid}`} className="border border-gray-300 bg-white mb-2" dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: BCL[gid].outer }} />
            <div className="text-[10px] text-gray-400">kit</div>
            <div data-cell={`k__${gid}`} className="border border-gray-300 bg-white"><LiveBreadcrumb group={gid} /></div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </section>
      <section>
        <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-800 mb-2">Live states measured on staging (hover / default)</h2>
        {live.map((gid) => (
          <div key={gid} className="border-b border-gray-200 py-3">
            <div className="text-xs text-gray-600 mb-1">{gid} · {BC_STATE_ROWS.find((r) => r.group === gid).route}</div>
            <div data-state-cell={gid} className="border border-gray-300 bg-white"><LiveBreadcrumb group={gid} /></div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </section>
    </div>
  )
}


=== FILE: src/pages/check/CheckButtons.jsx ===
// /check/buttons (19 Nov 2026): every kit button group — live captured markup beside the kit output.
// The captured hover / focus / disabled state rows also show the captured computed styles beside
// the kit's computed styles (the page measures kit styles client-side; kitshots.cjs re-measures
// in-state via puppeteer for the authoritative compare).
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'
import { LiveButton } from '../../components/Buttons.jsx'
import { BL } from '../../data/buttonsLive.js'
import { BUTTON_STATE_ROWS } from '../../data/buttonsCapturedStates.js'

const STYLE_PROPS = ['backgroundColor', 'color', 'borderColor', 'boxShadow', 'opacity']

function btnStyles(root) {
  const btn = root.querySelector('button, [role="button"]')
  if (!btn) return null
  const cs = window.getComputedStyle(btn)
  const o = {}
  STYLE_PROPS.forEach((p) => { o[p] = cs.getPropertyValue(p) || '' })
  return o
}

export default function CheckButtons() {
  const [kitStyles, setKitStyles] = useState({})
  useEffect(() => {
    const next = {}
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-cell]').forEach((el) => {
      next[el.dataset.cell] = btnStyles(el)
    })
    setKitStyles(next)
  }, [])

  const groupRows = Object.entries(BL).map(([gid, g]) => {
    const cell = (g && g.cells && g.cells.default) || {}
    return { gid, look: g.look, tag: g.tag, live: cell.outer || '', label: (cell && cell.label) || '' }
  })

  const liveStyles = (id) => { const s = kitStyles[id]; return s || {} }
  const captured = (r) => r.styles || {}

  return (
    <div className="bg-white p-4" style={{ fontFamily: 'Inter, sans-serif' }}>
      <h1 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900 mb-4">Buttons: live captured markup beside the kit, 19 Nov 2026</h1>
      <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mb-4">
        {groupRows.length} groups from _kit/src/data/buttonsLive.js rendered via LiveButton (dangerouslySetInnerHTML of the captured outerHTML), plus {BUTTON_STATE_ROWS.length} captured hover/focus/disabled state rows with captured vs kit computed styles (kit styles measured client-side; kitshots.cjs measures in-state for the authoritative compare).
      </p>

      <section className="mb-8">
        <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-800 mb-2">All {groupRows.length} groups — default cell</h2>
        {groupRows.map((r) => (
          <div key={r.gid} className="flex gap-6 items-start border-b border-gray-200 py-3">
            <div className="w-48 text-xs text-gray-600 shrink-0">
              {r.gid}&nbsp;·&nbsp;{r.tag}<br className="hidden" />
              <span className="text-gray-400">Look {r.look}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="w-96 shrink-0" style={{ padding: 10, minHeight: 44 }}>
              <div className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 mb-1">live</div>
              <div data-cell={`g__${r.gid}__default`} className="border border-gray-300 rounded p-2" dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: r.live }} />
            </div>
            <div className="flex-1 min-w-0" style={{ padding: 10, minHeight: 44 }}>
              <div className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 mb-1">kit</div>
              <div data-cell={`k__${r.gid}__default`} className="border border-gray-300 rounded p-2"><LiveButton group={r.gid} label={r.label} /></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </section>

      <section>
        <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-800 mb-2">Captured states: hover / focus / disabled ({BUTTON_STATE_ROWS.length} rows)</h2>
        {BUTTON_STATE_ROWS.map((r) => {
          const kitId = `k__s__${r.id}`
          const cap = captured(r)
          const kit = liveStyles(kitId)
          return (
            <div key={r.id} className="flex gap-6 items-start border-b border-gray-200 py-3">
              <div className="w-48 text-xs text-gray-600 shrink-0">
                {r.group}&nbsp;·&nbsp;{r.state}<br className="hidden" />
                <span className="text-gray-400">Look {r.look} · {r.capture.split('/').pop()}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="w-96 shrink-0" style={{ padding: 10, minHeight: 44 }}>
                <div className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 mb-1">live capture</div>
                <div data-cell={`s__${r.id}__live`} className="border border-gray-300 rounded p-2" dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: r.outer }} />
              </div>
              <div className="flex-1 min-w-0" style={{ padding: 10, minHeight: 44 }}>
                <div className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 mb-1">kit</div>
                <div data-cell={kitId} className="border border-gray-300 rounded p-2">
                  <LiveButton group={r.group} label={r.text} disabled={r.state === 'disabled'} variant={r.state === 'disabled' ? undefined : r.class} />
                </div>
                {Object.keys(cap).length > 0 && (
                  <div className="mt-3 p-2 border border-gray-200 rounded bg-gray-50 text-[10px]">
                    <div className="font-semibold mb-1">computed styles: captured vs kit</div>
                    <table className="text-[10px]">
                      <thead><tr><th className="text-left pl-1">prop</th><th className="text-left">captured</th><th className="text-left">kit (client-measured)</th></tr></thead>
                      <tbody>
                        {STYLE_PROPS.map((p) => (
                          <tr key={r.id + p}>
                            <td className="pl-1">{p}</td>
                            <td>{cap[p]}</td>
                            <td>{kit[p]}</td>
                          </tr>
                        ))}
                      </tbody>
                    </table>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          )
        })}
      </section>
    </div>
  )
}

// Step 7 check page (18 Nov 2026): every captured dropdown state — live screenshot (left) beside the kit (right).
// Option text: fixed app values are copied (Status, Records per page, Σ modes); people / tenant records get neutral sample text.
import { LiveSelect, LivePrimeMulti } from '../../components/Dropdowns.jsx'
import { DD } from '../../data/dropdownLive.js'

const SAMPLE = (n, f) => Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => f(i + 1))
const opts = (k, st = 'open') => DD[k].opts[st]?.text || DD[k].opts.open?.text || DD[k].opts.hover?.text
const SIGMA = (o) => DD.filter.opts.nomatch.inner[DD.filter.opts.nomatch.text.indexOf(o)] || o
const FORM_OPTS = SAMPLE(20, (i) => `Option ${i}`)
const PEOPLE = SAMPLE(19, (i) => `Sample Person ${i} (YO-${100 + i})`)
const BU = SAMPLE(12, (i) => `Business Unit ${i}`)
const MAILS = SAMPLE(11, (i) => `sender${i}@example.com`)

const CELLS = [
  ['form', 'closed', <LiveSelect variant="form" options={FORM_OPTS} />],
  ['form', 'open', <LiveSelect variant="form" options={FORM_OPTS} forceOpen hoverIndex={0} />],
  ['form', 'hover', <LiveSelect variant="form" options={FORM_OPTS} forceOpen hoverIndex={0} />],
  ['form', 'value', <LiveSelect variant="form" options={FORM_OPTS} value="Option 3" />],
  ['form', 'valueopen', <LiveSelect variant="form" options={FORM_OPTS} value="Option 1" forceOpen hoverIndex={0} />],
  ['form', 'nomatch', <LiveSelect variant="form" options={FORM_OPTS} forceOpen forceInput="zzqx" />],
  ['disabled', 'disabled', <LiveSelect variant="form" disabled options={[]} />],
  ['status', 'closed', <LiveSelect variant="status" options={opts('status')} />],
  ['status', 'open', <LiveSelect variant="status" options={opts('status')} forceOpen hoverIndex={0} />],
  ['status', 'hover', <LiveSelect variant="status" options={opts('status')} forceOpen hoverIndex={0} />],
  ['pagesize', 'closed', <LiveSelect variant="pagesize" options={opts('pagesize')} value="25" />],
  ['pagesize', 'open', <LiveSelect variant="pagesize" options={opts('pagesize')} value="25" forceOpen hoverIndex={0} />],
  ['pagesize', 'hover', <LiveSelect variant="pagesize" options={opts('pagesize')} value="25" forceOpen hoverIndex={0} />],
  ['filter', 'closed', <LiveSelect variant="filter" options={opts('filter', 'nomatch')} value="Look-up Filter" />],
  ['filter', 'nomatch', <LiveSelect variant="filter" options={opts('filter', 'nomatch')} value="Look-up Filter" forceOpen hoverIndex={0} menuInner={SIGMA} />],
  ['pm', 'closed', <LiveSelect variant="pm" options={opts('pm', 'nomatch')} value="Look-up Filter" />],
  ['pm', 'nomatch', <LiveSelect variant="pm" options={opts('pm', 'nomatch')} value="Look-up Filter" forceOpen hoverIndex={0} menuInner={SIGMA} />],
  ['table', 'closed', <LiveSelect variant="table" options={MAILS} value={MAILS[0]} />],
  ['table', 'open', <LiveSelect variant="table" options={MAILS} value={MAILS[1]} forceOpen hoverIndex={0} />],
  ['table', 'hover', <LiveSelect variant="table" options={MAILS} value={MAILS[1]} forceOpen hoverIndex={0} />],
  ['multi', 'closed', <LiveSelect variant="multi" options={PEOPLE} value={PEOPLE.slice(0, 2)} />],
  ['multi', 'open', <LiveSelect variant="multi" options={PEOPLE.concat(['x1', 'x2'])} value={PEOPLE.slice(0, 2)} forceOpen hoverIndex={0} />],
  ['multi', 'hover', <LiveSelect variant="multi" options={PEOPLE.concat(['x1', 'x2'])} value={PEOPLE.slice(0, 2)} forceOpen hoverIndex={0} />],
  ['multi', 'nomatch', <LiveSelect variant="multi" options={PEOPLE} value={PEOPLE.slice(0, 2)} forceOpen forceInput="zzqx" />],
  ['prime', 'closed', <LivePrimeMulti options={BU} values={[]} width={200} />],
  ['prime', 'open', <LivePrimeMulti options={BU} values={[]} width={200} forceOpen />],
  ['prime', 'hover', <LivePrimeMulti options={BU} values={[]} width={200} forceOpen hoverIndex={1} />],
  ['prime', 'value', <LivePrimeMulti options={BU} values={['2342342342424']} width={200} />],
]

export default function CheckDropdowns() {
  return (
    <div className="bg-white p-4" style={{ fontFamily: 'Inter, sans-serif' }}>
      <h1 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900 mb-4">Dropdowns: live (left) and kit (right), 18 Nov 2026</h1>
      {CELLS.map(([k, s, el]) => (
        <div key={k + s} className="flex gap-6 items-start border-b border-gray-200 py-3">
          <div className="w-40 text-xs text-gray-600 shrink-0">{k} · {s}<div className="text-gray-400">{DD[k]?.url}</div></div>
          <img src={`/check/dropdowns/${k}__${s}.png`} alt="" style={{ maxWidth: 560 }} />
          <div data-cell={`${k}__${s}`} style={{ padding: 10, minHeight: s === 'closed' || s === 'value' || s === 'disabled' ? 0 : 440, paddingTop: k === 'pagesize' && s !== 'closed' ? 200 : 10 }}>{DD[k]?.wrap ? <div className={DD[k].wrap} style={{ width: 'fit-content' }}>{el}</div> : el}</div>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}

/* COPIED from modules/admin/dom/helpdesk_help_menu_2026-10-05.html (a People page, yopmail): the People sidebar is bg-indigo-700.

   No active item exists in that capture (it was taken on a parent's page), so none is drawn. nav = [label, icon, path|null, addTitle?, addPath?] */
function PeopleSidebar({ nav, portal }) {

    <div>
      <div className="bg-indigo-700 w-[220px] duration-300 relative 2xl:min-h-[calc(100vh-60px)] 2xl-to-xl:min-h-[calc(100vh-52px)] min-h-[calc(100vh-52px)]">

                  <div className="text-white hover:bg-indigo-600 flex items-center rounded-md h-full w-full text-sm leading-6 font-semibold whitespace-nowrap">
                    <a className="flex w-full items-center gap-x-3 2xl:p-3 2xl-to-xl:p-2 p-2" href={`/${portal}/${TENANT}/${path}`}>
                      <span className={`text-indigo-200 group-hover:text-white h-6 w-6 shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap flex items-center justify-center 2xl:text-xl 2xl-to-xl:text-lg text-lg icon-${icon}`} />

                    </a>
                    {addPath && <a title={addTitle} className="icon-plus-square block ml-auto text-xl 2xl:p-3 2xl-to-xl:p-2 p-2 text-indigo-300" href={`/${portal}/${TENANT}/${addPath}`} />}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </li>
            ) : (
              <li key={label} title={label} className="relative group cursor-pointer">
                <div className="text-white hover:bg-indigo-600 relative z-2 cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-x-3 rounded-md 2xl:p-3 2xl-to-xl:p-2 p-2 text-sm leading-6 font-semibold whitespace-nowrap">

                  <span className="icon-chevron-right block ml-auto text-xl text-indigo-300" />
                </div>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </nav>
        <div className="z-[51] bg-gray-50 absolute top-0 duration-300 overflow-hidden shadow-md whitespace-nowrap w-[0px] left-[220px] 2xl:h-[calc(100vh-60px)] 2xl-to-xl:h-[calc(100vh-52px)] h-[calc(100vh-52px)]">

            <div role="button" className="relative rounded-lg group before:absolute before:top-1/2 before:left-1/2 before:-translate-x-1/2 before:-translate-y-1/2 before:w-full before:h-full before:bg-gray-100 hover:before:scale-150 before:rounded-sm hover:before:opacity-100 before:opacity-0 before:transition-all before:duration-300">

/* COPIED from modules/project-mgmt/dom/issue_board.html (PM › Tasks › Board, 1 Sep 2026; tojsx.py, graph step 5, 18 Nov 2026).
   The PM sidebar is bg-indigo-700 like People, NOT the white Administration one. Differences from People: icon size classes,
   the active item (bg-indigo-600 + white icon), the quick links on Projects (+ Add Project) and Tasks (bell = Task Notifications),
   and the closed flyout panel (chevron-right-double button, h3 with the open parent's name).
   nav = [label, icon, path]; quick links come from PM_QUICK below (same hrefs as the capture). */
const PM_QUICK = {
  Projects: { title: 'Add Project', path: 'project/add', cls: 'icon-plus-square block ml-auto 2xl:text-xl 2xl-to-xl:text-lg text-lg 2xl:p-3 2xl-to-xl:p-2 p-2 text-indigo-300' },
  Tasks: { title: 'Task Notifications', path: 'tasks/notifications/all', cls: 'icon-bell-01 block ml-auto text-xl 2xl:p-3 2xl-to-xl:p-2 p-2 relative text-indigo-300' },
}
function PmSidebar({ nav, activeLabel, portal, flyout = '' }) {
  return (
    <div className="">
      <div className="bg-indigo-700 w-[220px] duration-300 relative 2xl:min-h-[calc(100vh-60px)] 2xl-to-xl:min-h-[calc(100vh-52px)] min-h-[calc(100vh-52px)]">
        <nav className="py-5 px-2 overflow-y-auto overflow-x-hidden sidebar-container 2xl:h-[calc(100vh-116px)] 2xl-to-xl:h-[calc(100vh-108px)] h-[calc(100vh-108px)]">
          <ul role="list" className="space-y-3 sidebar-container">
            {nav.map(([label, icon, path]) => {
              const active = label === activeLabel
              const q = PM_QUICK[label]
              return (
                <li key={label} title={label} className="group cursor-pointer relative">
                  <div className="-my-1">
                    <div className={active
                      ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white flex items-center rounded-md h-full w-full text-sm leading-6 font-semibold whitespace-nowrap'
                      : 'text-white hover:bg-indigo-600 flex items-center rounded-md h-full w-full text-sm leading-6 font-semibold whitespace-nowrap'}>
                      <a className="flex w-full items-center 2xl:p-3 2xl-to-xl:p-2 p-2 gap-x-3" href={`/${portal}/${TENANT}/${path}`}>
                        <span className={`${active ? 'text-white' : 'text-indigo-200 group-hover:text-white'} h-6 w-6 shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap flex items-center justify-center text-base 2xl-to-xl:text-base 2xl:text-xl icon-${icon}`} />
                        <p>{label}</p>
                      </a>
                      {q && <a title={q.title} className={q.cls} href={`/${portal}/${TENANT}/${q.path}`} />}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </li>
              )
            })}
          </ul>
          <div className="z-50 bg-gray-50 2xl:h-[calc(100vh-60px)] 2xl-to-xl:h-[calc(100vh-52px)] h-[calc(100vh-52px)] absolute top-0 duration-300 overflow-hidden shadow-md w-[0px] left-[220px]">
            <div className="flex justify-end w-full">
              <div role="button" className="bg-white hover:bg-[#EEF4FF] rounded-l-lg rounded-r-none border border-gray-200 hover:border-[#C7D7FE] group p-1.5">
                <span className="icon-chevron-right-double flex text-lg text-gray-800 group-hover:text-slate-950 cursor-pointer" />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="px-5 pb-5">
              <h3 className="text-black font-medium text-md capitalize">{flyout}</h3>
              <ul className="mt-4" />
            </div>
          </div>
        </nav>
        <div className="group flex items-center py-[18px] px-8 gap-x-2 text-sm leading-6 font-semibold whitespace-nowrap bg-indigo-800 text-indigo-200 cursor-pointer justify-start">
          <span className="icon-chevron-left-double text-xl text-white block text-indigo-300" />
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-white">Collapse</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

/* Recruitment, Reports, Payroll, CRM & Invoice: their own sidebars, copied from the captures (PortalSidebars.jsx, 18 Nov 2026).
   The capture wraps each in a class-less <div>, as PmSidebar does. */
const OWN_SIDEBAR = { recruitment: RecruitmentSidebar, reports: ReportsSidebar, payroll: PayrollSidebar, 'sales-crm': CrmSidebar }
function Sidebar(props) {
  if (props.portal === 'project-management') return <PmSidebar {...props} />
  const Own = OWN_SIDEBAR[props.portal]
  if (Own) return <div><Own {...props} /></div>
  return props.portal === 'people' ? <PeopleSidebar {...props} /> : <AdminSidebar {...props} />
}

function AdminSidebar({ nav, activeLabel, portal }) {
  return (
    <div className="">
      <div className="bg-white w-[220px] duration-300 relative 2xl:h-[calc(100vh-60px)] 2xl-to-xl:h-[calc(100vh-52px)] h-[calc(100vh-52px)]">
        <nav className="py-5 px-2 overflow-auto sidebar-container border-r 2xl:h-[calc(100vh-116px)] 2xl-to-xl:h-[calc(100vh-108px)] h-[calc(100vh-108px)]">
          <ul role="list" className="space-y-3 sidebar-container">
            {/* COPIED from admin/dom/email_status_live_default_2026-09-29.html:
                active = solid bg-indigo-600 + white; a sub-menu item (Master
                Data) is a div with a chevron, not a link. */}
            {nav.map(([label, icon, path]) => {
              const active = label === activeLabel
              if (!path) {
                return (
                  <li key={label} title={label} className="group cursor-pointer relative ">
                    <div className="text-red hover:bg-indigo-600 cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-x-3 rounded-md p-3 text-sm leading-6 font-semibold whitespace-nowrap">
                      <span className={`text-gray-400 group-hover:text-white h-6 w-6 shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap flex items-center justify-center 2xl:text-xl 2xl-to-xl:text-base text-base icon-${icon}`}></span>
                      <p className="text-gray-500 group-hover:text-white">{label}</p>
                      <span className="icon-chevron-right block ml-auto text-xl text-gray-500 group-hover:text-white"></span>
                    </div>
                  </li>
                )
              }
              return (
                <li key={label} title={label} className="group cursor-pointer relative ">
                  <div className="-my-1">
                    <div className={active
                      ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white flex items-center rounded-md h-full w-full text-sm leading-6 font-semibold whitespace-nowrap'
                      : 'text-white hover:bg-indigo-600 flex items-center rounded-md h-full w-full text-sm leading-6 font-semibold whitespace-nowrap'}>

export function Breadcrumb({ trail }) {
  return (
    <nav className="flex border-b border-gray-200 py-2 bg-white items-center justify-between px-4" aria-label="Breadcrumb">
      <ol className="flex items-center space-x-2 overflow-x-auto flex-nowrap no-scrollbar scrollbar-hide sm:flex-wrap">
        <li>
          <div className="flex items-center">
            <a className="hover:text-gray-700 text-gray-500 sm:whitespace-normal whitespace-nowrap" href="#">
              <span className="icon-home-line flex-shrink-0 text-lg flex"></span>
            </a>
          </div>
        </li>
        {trail.map((t, i) => (
          <li key={t.label + i}>
            <div className="flex items-center">
              <span className="icon-chevron-right flex-shrink-0 text-base text-gray-300"></span>
              {t.to && i < trail.length - 1 ? (
                <Link className="text-gray-600 cursor-pointer hover:text-gray-800 ml-4 2xl:text-sm 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs font-medium sm:whitespace-normal whitespace-nowrap" to={t.to}>{t.label}</Link>
              ) : (
                <a className="text-indigo-700 cursor-default pointer-events-none ml-4 2xl:text-sm 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs font-medium sm:whitespace-normal whitespace-nowrap">{t.label}</a>
              )}
            </div>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ol>
    </nav>
  )
}

export function Tabs({ items, active, onChange }) {
  const base = 'tab-transition font-semibold relative z-[20] whitespace-nowrap 2xl:py-2 2xl-to-xl:py-1.5 py-1.5 2xl:px-3 2xl-to-xl:px-2 px-2 w-max 2xl:text-sm 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs text-center rounded-md'
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center justify-between w-full px-3 py-2">
      <div className="w-full flex items-center px-3">
        <div className="block w-full">
          <nav aria-label="Tabs" className="scrollbar-hide tab flex gap-3 items-center relative overflow-x-auto overflow-y-hidden horizontal-scrollbar-hide scrollbar-hide">
            {items.map((t, i) => (
              <a key={t} id={`tab-${i}`} aria-current={t === active ? 'page' : undefined} onClick={() => onChange && onChange(t)}
                 className={t === active ? `text-indigo-700 bg-indigo-50 ${base} active` : `text-gray-500 ${base}`}>{t}</a>
            ))}
          </nav>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

import { BCL } from '../data/breadcrumbLive.js'

function parseHTML(html) {
  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return null
  const tpl = document.createElement('template')
  tpl.innerHTML = html
  return tpl.content
}

function setText(li, label) {
  const leaf = [...li.querySelectorAll('a, span, button, div')].reverse().find((e) => !/(^|\s)icon-/.test(e.className || '') && !e.children.length && e.textContent.trim())
  if (leaf) leaf.textContent = label
}

export function LiveBreadcrumb({ group = 'bc-001', trail, right = true }) {
  const g = BCL[group]
  if (!g) return null
  const frag = parseHTML(g.outer)
  const nav = frag && frag.firstElementChild
  if (!nav) return <div style={{ display: 'contents' }} dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: g.outer }} />
  const ol = nav.querySelector('ol')
  if (trail && ol) {
    const lis = [...ol.children]
    const cur = lis[lis.length - 1]
    const mid = lis.length > 2 ? lis[1] : cur
    lis.slice(1).forEach((li) => li.remove())
    trail.forEach((label, i) => {
      const li = (i === trail.length - 1 ? cur : mid).cloneNode(true)
      setText(li, label)
      ol.appendChild(li)
    })
  }
  if (!right && ol) [...nav.children].forEach((c) => { if (c !== ol && !c.contains(ol)) c.remove() })
  return <div style={{ display: 'contents' }} dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: nav.outerHTML }} />
}

import { BL } from '../data/buttonsLive.js'

function parseHTML(html) {
  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return null
  const tpl = document.createElement('template')
  tpl.innerHTML = html
  return tpl.content
}

function setLabel(el, text) {
  const label = String(text)
  const p = el.querySelector('p')
  if (p && !p.querySelector('[class*="icon-"]')) { p.textContent = label; return }
  for (const node of Array.from(el.childNodes)) {
    if (node.nodeType === 3 && node.textContent.trim()) { node.textContent = label; return }
  }
  const span = Array.from(el.children).find((c) => c.tagName.toLowerCase() === 'span' && !/icon-|rounded|border|badge/.test(c.className || '') && !c.children.length)
  if (span) { span.textContent = label; return }
  if (!el.children.length) { el.textContent = label; return }
  for (const leaf of el.querySelectorAll('span,p')) { if (!leaf.children.length && leaf.textContent.trim() && !/^\d+$/.test(leaf.textContent.trim())) { leaf.textContent = label; return } }
}

// `variant` (19 Nov): the exact live class string to draw when a group holds several (BL[group].variants, copied from the
// captures that the hover/focus states were measured on); falls back to the group's default cell.
export function LiveButton({ group = 'primary-001', label, disabled, icon, variant }) {
  const g = BL[group]
  if (!g || !g.cells) return null
  const cells = g.cells
  let cell = cells.default
  const v = variant && g.variants && g.variants[variant.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).join(' ')]
  if (disabled && cells.disabled) cell = cells.disabled
  else if (v) cell = v
  else if (icon && cells.iconOnly) cell = cells.iconOnly
  if (!cell || !cell.outer) return null
  const frag = parseHTML(cell.outer)
  const container = frag && frag.firstElementChild
  if (!container) return <div style={{ display: 'contents' }} dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: cell.outer }} />
  if (label != null && label !== cell.label) setLabel(container, label)
  return <div style={{ display: 'contents' }} dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: container.outerHTML }} />
}

const byLook = {}
for (const gid of Object.keys(BL)) {
  const look = BL[gid].look || '?'
  ;(byLook[look] = byLook[look] || []).push(gid)
}
export const LOOKS = Object.fromEntries(
  Object.entries(byLook).sort((a, b) => b[1].length - a[1].length || a[0].localeCompare(b[0]))
)

import { useEffect, useSyncExternalStore } from 'react'

/* CollabCRM's own confirmation dialog, in place of the browser's confirm() —
   "localhost:5173 says …" is not something the product ever shows.

   COPIED from modules/project-mgmt/dom/c2_row_action.html (the "Delete
   Resource" dialog): dimmed backdrop, centred sm:max-w-lg card, the round
   two-ring badge with an icon, title + message, and two full-width buttons —
   white Cancel, red confirm. Only the icon and the words change per use.

   Usage, anywhere:  if (await askConfirm({ title, message, confirmLabel })) …  */

let current = null            // { title, message, confirmLabel, cancelLabel, icon, resolve }
const subs = new Set()
const emit = () => subs.forEach((f) => f())

export function askConfirm({ title, message, confirmLabel = 'Confirm', cancelLabel = 'Cancel', icon = 'alert-triangle' }) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    current?.resolve(false)   // a second ask replaces the first
    current = { title, message, confirmLabel, cancelLabel, icon, resolve }
    emit()
  })
}

const answer = (ok) => {
  if (!current) return
  const { resolve } = current
  current = null
  emit()
  resolve(ok)
}

/* Mounted once, in App. */
export function ConfirmHost() {
  const d = useSyncExternalStore((f) => { subs.add(f); return () => subs.delete(f) }, () => current)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!d) return
    const onKey = (e) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') { e.preventDefault(); answer(false) } }
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey)
  }, [d])

  if (!d) return null
  return (
    <div className="relative z-[999]" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label={d.title}>
      <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-gray-900 opacity-70" onClick={() => answer(false)} />
      <div className="fixed inset-0 overflow-y-auto pointer-events-none">
        <div className="flex min-h-full items-center justify-center p-4 ">
          <div className="w-full max-w-full sm:max-w-lg relative pointer-events-auto">
            <div className="2xl:p-4 2xl-to-xl:p-3 p-3 overflow-hidden border-0 rounded-lg shadow-lg relative flex flex-col w-full bg-white outline-none focus:outline-none">
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                <span className="bg-error-50 p-2 w-[55px] rounded-full flex justify-center items-center">
                  <span className="bg-error-100 p-2 rounded-full flex justify-center items-center w-10">
                    <span className={`text-xl text-error-600 icon-${d.icon}`} />
                  </span>
                </span>
                <span className="icon-x-close cursor-pointer text-2xl text-gray-500 mb-5" onClick={() => answer(false)} />
              </div>
              <div className="z-10">
                <div className="relative z-1 mt-4">
                  <p className="text-gray-900 font-semibold 2xl:text-lg 2xl-to-xl:text-base text-base pt-1">{d.title}</p>
                  {d.message && <div className="mt-1 text-gray-600 font-normal text-sm"><div className="mb-3">{d.message}</div></div>}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="w-full gap-x-3 flex pt-4 justify-between">
                <button type="button" onClick={() => answer(false)}
                  className="outline-none rounded-lg disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-100 hover:opacity-90 px-4 bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 hover:bg-gray-50 !bg-white border border-gray-300 !text-gray-700 2xl:py-2 2xl-to-xl:py-[7px] py-[7px] 2xl:text-sm 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs font-semibold w-full">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2">{d.cancelLabel}</div>
                </button>
                <button type="button" autoFocus onClick={() => answer(true)}
                  className="outline-none rounded-lg disabled:cursor-not-allowed border disabled:opacity-100 hover:opacity-90 disabled:bg-indigo-200 px-4 border-transparent text-white focus:border-error-400 focus:shadow-outline-error w-full font-semibold 2xl:py-2 2xl-to-xl:py-[7px] py-[7px] 2xl:text-sm 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs bg-error-600">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2">{d.confirmLabel}</div>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

// Dropdowns copied from the LIVE app (yopmail staging, 18 Nov 2026) — Step 7 of the component library.
// Every class string, icon and CSS rule comes from _kit/src/data/dropdownLive.js + _kit/src/dropdowns-live.css, generated by
// _graph/jobs/dropdowns-2026-11-18/extract.py from live state captures. Nothing here is typed from memory: this file only decides
// WHICH captured state to show (closed / open / hover / value / no match / disabled) and puts the option text in.
//
// <LiveSelect variant=…>   react-select, the same DOM the app renders. Variants (where each was captured live):
//   form      field on add/edit forms             CRM › Companies › Add › Industry      (closed 1ltf6eg, focused/open tmene0)
//   disabled  a form field that waits for another  CRM › Companies › Add › State         (gjy5sx)
//   status    form field with coloured dots        People › Employee › Add › Status      (Intern / Probation / Confirmed)
//   pagesize  records per page under every list    CRM › Companies (opens upwards)        (10 / 25 / 50 / 100)
//   filter    Σ search-mode picker in list search  CRM › Companies                       (Look-up Filter / Quick Search)
//   pm        the same Σ picker in Project Mgmt    PM › Projects
//   table     borderless select inside a table row Administration › Email Status
//   multi     chips multi-select (isMulti)         CRM › Config › Operational Config › Edit

// Full live pages these were copied from (graph links them):
//   modules/crm-invoice/dom/yop_dropdowns_form_2026-11-18.html     modules/crm-invoice/dom/yop_dropdowns_filter_2026-11-18.html
