import { useState, useRef, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react'
import { DD } from '../data/dropdownLive.js'
import '../dropdowns-live.css'

const css2obj = (s = '') => Object.fromEntries(s.split(';').map((d) => d.split(':')).filter((p) => p.length > 1 && p[0].trim())
  .map(([k, ...v]) => [k.trim().replace(/-([a-z])/g, (_, c) => c.toUpperCase()), v.join(':').trim()]))
const isFocusedCls = (c) => /--is-focused/.test(c)
const isSelectedCls = (c) => /--is-selected/.test(c)

// Option classes per index, read from every captured open list: normal / focused / selected.
function optionTable(v) {
  const lists = Object.entries(v.opts || {}).filter(([, o]) => o.cls && o.cls.length > 1)
  const all = lists.flatMap(([, o]) => o.cls)
  const count = {}; all.forEach((c) => { count[c] = (count[c] || 0) + 1 })
  const plain = Object.keys(count).filter((c) => !isFocusedCls(c) && !isSelectedCls(c)).sort((a, b) => count[b] - count[a])
  const normal = plain[0]
  const prefixless = !/react-select__option/.test(all[0] || '')
  // prefix-less (multi): the focused option is the one in the hover list (index 1) whose class differs from the normal one
  const focused = all.find((c) => isFocusedCls(c) && !isSelectedCls(c)) || (prefixless && v.opts.hover ? v.opts.hover.cls.find((c) => c !== normal) : null) || normal
  const selected = all.find((c) => isSelectedCls(c)) || null
  const focusedSelected = all.find((c) => isSelectedCls(c) && isFocusedCls(c)) || selected
  // per-index colours (Status dots): the same index keeps its own hash in every list
  const perIdx = {}
  lists.forEach(([, o]) => o.cls.forEach((c, i) => { const slot = (perIdx[i] = perIdx[i] || {}); if (isFocusedCls(c)) slot.focused = c; else slot.normal = slot.normal || c }))
  const distinct = new Set(Object.values(perIdx).map((s) => s.normal)).size === Object.keys(perIdx).length && Object.keys(perIdx).length > 2 && !selected
  return { normal, focused, selected, focusedSelected, perIdx: distinct ? perIdx : null }
}

export function LiveSelect({ variant = 'form', options = [], value = null, onChange, placeholder, disabled = false, searchable,
  forceOpen = false, hoverIndex = null, forceInput = null, width, id = 3, menuInner = null }) {
  const v = DD[disabled ? 'disabled' : variant] || DD.form
  const isMulti = variant === 'multi'
  const canSearch = searchable ?? ['form', 'status', 'table', 'multi'].includes(variant)
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(forceOpen)
  const [input, setInput] = useState(forceInput ?? '')
  const [hover, setHover] = useState(hoverIndex)
  const ref = useRef(null)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (forceOpen) return
    const h = (e) => { if (ref.current && !ref.current.contains(e.target)) { setOpen(false); setInput('') } }
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', h, true); return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', h, true)
  }, [forceOpen])
  const vals = isMulti ? (value || []) : (value != null && value !== '' ? [value] : [])
  const shown = options.filter((o) => !input || String(o).toLowerCase().includes(input.toLowerCase())).filter((o) => !isMulti || !vals.includes(o))
  const noMatch = open && shown.length === 0
  // which captured state to copy
  const withMenu = (...xs) => xs.find((x) => x && x.menu) || xs.find(Boolean)
  const st = disabled ? (v.st.disabled || v.st.field) : open ? (noMatch && v.st.nomatch ? v.st.nomatch
      : withMenu(vals.length && !isMulti ? v.st.valueopen : null, v.st.open, v.st.hover, v.st.nomatch))
    : vals.length && !v.st.closed?.singleValue && !v.st.closed?.multiValue && v.st.value ? v.st.value : v.st.closed
  const stName = Object.keys(v.st).find((k) => v.st[k] === st)
  const html = v.html[stName] || {}
  const ot = useMemo(() => optionTable(v), [v])
  const pick = (o) => { if (isMulti) onChange?.([...vals, o]); else { onChange?.(o); setOpen(false) } setInput('') }
  const toggle = (e) => { if (disabled || forceOpen) return; if (e.target.closest('[data-clear]')) return; setOpen((x) => !x) }
  const onIndicators = (e) => {   // the clear "x" is the first indicator when there is a value (react-select order: clear, dropdown)
    const ind = e.currentTarget.children; if (vals.length && ind.length > 1 && ind[0].contains(e.target)) { e.stopPropagation(); onChange?.(isMulti ? [] : null) }
  }
  const optCls = (i, o) => {
    const idx = options.indexOf(o)
    if (ot.perIdx && ot.perIdx[idx]) return hover === i ? (ot.perIdx[idx].focused || ot.perIdx[idx].normal) : ot.perIdx[idx].normal
    const sel = vals.includes(o) && !isMulti
    if (sel) return hover === i ? ot.focusedSelected : (ot.selected || ot.normal)
    return hover === i ? ot.focused : ot.normal
  }
  const inputEl = canSearch && st.input != null
    ? <div className={st.inputContainer} data-value={input}>
        <input className={st.input} autoCapitalize="none" autoComplete="off" autoCorrect="off" id={`react-select-${id}-input`} spellCheck="false" tabIndex="0"
          type="text" aria-autocomplete="list" aria-expanded={open} aria-haspopup="true" role="combobox" aria-activedescendant="" value={input}
          disabled={disabled} onChange={(e) => { setInput(e.target.value); setOpen(true) }} style={css2obj(st.inputStyle)} />
      </div>
    : html.dummyInput ? <span style={{ display: 'contents' }} dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: html.dummyInput }} /> : null
  return (
    <div ref={ref} className={st.container} style={width ? { width } : v.w ? { width: v.w } : undefined}>
      <span id={`react-select-${id}-live-region`} className={st.a11y} />
      {/* react-select's screen-reader log: filled while the select has focus (open, or just picked), texts in react-select's own words (live) */}
      {st.a11yLog
        ? <span aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="false" aria-relevant="additions text" role="log" className={st.a11y}>
            <span id="aria-selection">{vals.length && !isMulti ? `option ${vals[0]}, selected.` : ''}</span>
            <span id="aria-focused" />
            <span id="aria-results">{open ? (noMatch && input ? `0 results available for search term ${input}.` : `${shown.length} results available.`) : ''}</span>
            <span id="aria-guidance">{v.a11yGuidance || DD.form.a11yGuidance}</span>
          </span>
        : <span aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="false" aria-relevant="additions text" role="log" className={st.a11y} />}
      <div className={st.control} onMouseDown={(e) => { if (e.target.tagName !== 'INPUT') e.preventDefault(); toggle(e) }} aria-disabled={disabled || undefined}>
        <div className={st.valueContainer}>
          {isMulti && vals.map((o) => (
            <div key={o} className={st.multiValue || v.st.closed.multiValue}>
              <div className={st.multiValueLabel || v.st.closed.multiValueLabel}>{o}</div>
              <div role="button" className={st.multiValueRemove || v.st.closed.multiValueRemove} aria-label={`Remove ${o}`}
                onMouseDown={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); onChange?.(vals.filter((x) => x !== o)) }}
                dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: html.multiValueRemove || v.html.closed.multiValueRemove }} />
            </div>
          ))}
          {!isMulti && !input && (vals.length
            ? (html.singleValue && !options.length) || (html.singleValue && /icon-/.test(html.singleValue))
              ? <div className={st.singleValue || v.st.value?.singleValue} dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: html.singleValue }} />
              : <div className={st.singleValue || v.st.value?.singleValue || v.st.closed.singleValue}>{vals[0]}</div>
            : <div className={st.placeholder || v.st.closed.placeholder}>{placeholder ?? 'Select'}</div>)}
          {inputEl}
        </div>
        <div className={st.indicators} onMouseDown={onIndicators} dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: indicatorsFor(v, stName, vals.length > 0) }} />
      </div>
      {open && st.menu && (
        // live: react-select portals the menu (menu-portal) with a position computed for that page; DIVERGES: here the portal is placed on the box
        <MenuPortal cls={st.menuPortal} up={v.menuUp}>
        <div className={st.menu}>
          <div className={st.menuList}>
            {noMatch
              ? <div className={v.st.nomatch?.notice || st.notice}>{(v.html.nomatch?.notice) || 'No options'}</div>
              : shown.map((o, i) => (
                <div key={o} className={optCls(i, o)} onMouseEnter={() => setHover(i)} onMouseDown={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); pick(o) }}
                  aria-disabled="false" tabIndex="-1">{menuInner ? <span style={{ display: 'contents' }} dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: menuInner(o) }} /> : o}</div>
              ))}
          </div>
        </div>
        </MenuPortal>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
const MenuPortal = ({ cls, up, children }) => cls
  ? <div className={cls} style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 0, width: '100%', top: up ? 0 : '100%', zIndex: 9999 }}>{children}</div>
  : children

// indicators markup, verbatim from the matching state; a closed select WITH a value uses the 'value' capture (it carries the clear x)
function indicatorsFor(v, stName, hasValue) {
  const h = v.html[stName]?.indicators ?? v.html.closed?.indicators ?? ''
  if (!hasValue || /clear/.test(h) || !v.html.value?.indicators) return h
  if (stName === 'closed' && /clear/.test(v.html.value.indicators)) return v.html.value.indicators
  return h
}

// ── PrimeReact multi-select with checkboxes (CRM list "Select Business Unit" filter) ──
export function LivePrimeMulti({ options = [], values = [], onChange, placeholder = 'Select Business Unit', forceOpen = false, hoverIndex = null, width }) {
  const v = DD.prime
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(forceOpen)
  const [hover, setHover] = useState(hoverIndex)
  const [q, setQ] = useState('')
  const ref = useRef(null)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (forceOpen) return
    const h = (e) => { if (ref.current && !ref.current.contains(e.target)) setOpen(false) }
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', h, true); return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', h, true)
  }, [forceOpen])
  useEffect(() => { if (open) ref.current?.querySelector('.p-multiselect-panel input')?.focus() }, [open])   // live: the search box gets focus on open
  const st = open ? (hover != null ? v.st.hover : v.st.open) : values.length ? v.st.value : v.st.closed
  const sn = open ? (hover != null ? 'hover' : 'open') : values.length ? 'value' : 'closed'
  const html = v.html[sn] || {}
  const item = (v.opts.open || v.opts.hover).inner[0]       // one captured <li> inside: checkbox + label
  const itemHtml = (o, checked) => item.replace(/(<p[^>]*>)[^<]*(<\/p>)/, `$1${o.replace(/</g, '&lt;')}$2`)
    .replace(/(<input class="border[^"]*")/, checked ? '$1 checked' : '$1')
  const liCls = (i) => (hover === i ? (v.opts.hover.cls.find((c) => /p-focus/.test(c)) || 'p-multiselect-item p-focus') : 'p-multiselect-item')
  const shown = options.filter((o) => !q || o.toLowerCase().includes(q.toLowerCase()))
  const toggleVal = (o) => onChange?.(values.includes(o) ? values.filter((x) => x !== o) : [...values, o])
  return (
    <div ref={ref} className={st.root} style={{ position: 'relative', ...(width ? { width } : {}) }} onMouseDown={(e) => { if (!forceOpen && !e.target.closest('.p-multiselect-panel')) setOpen((x) => !x) }}>
      <div className={v.st.closed.hidden} dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: v.html.closed.hidden || '' }} />
      <div className={st.labelContainer}>
        <div className={st.label}>
          {values.length ? values.map((o) => (
            <div key={o} className={v.st.value.token}>
              <span className={v.st.value.tokenLabel}>{o}</span>
              <span className={v.st.value.tokenIcon} onMouseDown={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); toggleVal(o) }} />
            </div>
          )) : placeholder}
        </div>
      </div>
      {values.length > 0 && v.html.value.clearIcon && <span style={{ display: 'contents' }} onMouseDown={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); onChange?.([]) }} dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: v.html.value.clearIcon }} />}
      <div className={st.trigger} dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: html.trigger || v.html.closed.trigger }} />
      {open && (
        // DIVERGES: PrimeReact appends the panel to <body> with a computed top/left; here it sits under the box (position from the box).
        <div className={v.st.open.panel} style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 'calc(100% + 4px)', left: 0, zIndex: 1000, minWidth: '100%' }}>
          <span style={{ display: 'contents' }} dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: v.html.open.panelHidden || '' }} />
          <div className={v.st.open.header} onInput={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)} dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: v.html.open.header }} />
          <div className={v.st.open.itemsWrapper} style={css2obj(v.html.open.itemsWrapperStyle || 'max-height: 200px')}>
            <ul className={v.st.open.items} role="listbox" aria-multiselectable="true">
              {shown.map((o, i) => (
                <li key={o} className={liCls(i)} role="option" aria-selected={values.includes(o)} onMouseEnter={() => setHover(i)}
                  onMouseDown={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); toggleVal(o) }} dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: itemHtml(o, values.includes(o)) }} />
              ))}
            </ul>
          </div>
          <span style={{ display: 'contents' }} dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: v.html.open.panelHidden || '' }} />
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

=== FILE: src/components/Select.jsx ===
// Reproduces react-select's rendered DOM exactly as it appears in the crawled page — same css-* hashes, same react-select__* class names.
// react-select's emotion CSS is NOT in the DOM, so layout that emotion supplies (position, display, cursor, width, menu box) is drawn with
// inline `style`, never with extra Tailwind classes — the class strings stay exactly the real ones.
// Open menu: COPIED react-select__menu / __menu-list / __option class strings from the crawled library (css-1nmdiq5-menu, css-qr46ko, css-1lmhnew-option …).
import { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react'

/* Computed styles read off the live beta screen — the row selects are
   BORDERLESS and transparent; only the tenant picker has a border. */
const CONTROL = {
  'css-jnq93n-control':  { height: 38, minHeight: 38, borderRadius: 4, border: 0, background: 'transparent' },
  'css-9pmlob-control':  { height: 'var(--hd-control-h)', minHeight: 'var(--hd-control-h)', borderRadius: 8, border: '1px solid #d0d5dd', background: '#fff' },   // super-admin queue filters (bordered, no capture of the emotion CSS)
  'css-1d2ikgd-control': { height: 'var(--hd-control-h)', minHeight: 'var(--hd-control-h)', borderRadius: 8, border: '1px solid #d0d5dd', background: '#fff' },   // 11b: same height + radius as the input
}
const T = '2xl:text-sm 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs'

// The open menu is positioned `fixed` from the control's on-screen box, so a parent with overflow-hidden (modal, drawer, table)
// can never cut it (BA, 5 Oct: "Assign ticket" menu was cut). It opens upwards when there is no room below, and FOLLOWS the control
// when anything scrolls or the control grows (a chip added) — it never closes by itself.
function useMenuBox(ref, open, setOpen, grow = 0) {
  const [box, setBox] = useState(null)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open || !ref.current) { setBox(null); return }
    const place = () => {
      if (!ref.current) return
      const r = ref.current.getBoundingClientRect(); const below = window.innerHeight - r.bottom
      setBox(below < 220 && r.top > below ? { left: r.left, width: r.width, bottom: window.innerHeight - r.top + 4 } : { left: r.left, width: r.width, top: r.bottom + 4 })
    }
    place()
    window.addEventListener('scroll', place, true); window.addEventListener('resize', place)
    return () => { window.removeEventListener('scroll', place, true); window.removeEventListener('resize', place) }
  }, [open, grow])   // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  return box ? { position: 'fixed', zIndex: 1000, ...box } : { display: 'none' }
}

// containerCls: extra real class on the container ('text-bold' on Records Per Page, 'capitalize' on Priority). width: CSS width (number = px).
// colors = { label: 'rgb(…)' } (BA 8 Oct #17, PM issue status): the control is filled with the chosen status's colour and white text, and each option
// gets its colour dot — computed styles read off staging (data/issues.js ISSUE_COLOURS). DIVERGES: the real dot is the option's ::before; here a span.
export default function Select({ value, options, onChange, width = 230, containerCls = '', controlCls = 'css-jnq93n-control', id = 3, indicatorCls = 'css-1xc3v61-indicatorContainer', placeholder, defaultOpen = false, colors = null, disabled = false }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(defaultOpen)
  const ref = useRef(null)
  const menuBox = useMenuBox(ref, open, setOpen)
  useEffect(() => {
    const h = (e) => { if (ref.current && !ref.current.contains(e.target)) setOpen(false) }
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', h, true)
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', h, true)
  }, [])
  return (
    <div ref={ref} style={{ position: 'relative', width }} className={`${containerCls ? containerCls + ' ' : ''}${T} css-b62m3t-container`}>
      <span id={`react-select-${id}-live-region`} className="css-7pg0cj-a11yText" />
      <span aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="false" aria-relevant="additions text" role="log" className="css-7pg0cj-a11yText" />
      <div onClick={() => !disabled && setOpen((o) => !o)}
           style={{ ...CONTROL[controlCls] || CONTROL['css-jnq93n-control'], display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between',
             cursor: disabled ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer', opacity: disabled ? 0.6 : 1, ...(disabled ? { background: '#f9fafb' } : {}),
             ...(colors?.[value] ? { background: colors[value], border: `1px solid ${colors[value]}`, borderRadius: 6, color: '#fff' } : {}) }}
           className={`${T} react-select__control ${controlCls}`}>
        <div style={{ padding: '2px 8px', display: 'grid', alignItems: 'center', flex: 1, overflow: 'hidden' }}
             className={`${T} react-select__value-container ${T} react-select__value-container--has-value css-hlgwow`}>
          {value || !placeholder
            ? <div style={{ gridArea: '1 / 1 / 2 / 3', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap', ...(colors?.[value] ? { color: '#fff' } : {}) }} className={`${T} react-select__single-value css-1dimb5e-singleValue`}>{value}</div>
            : <div style={{ gridArea: '1 / 1 / 2 / 3', color: '#667085' }} className={`${T} react-select__placeholder css-1jqq78o-placeholder`}>{placeholder}</div>}
          <div style={{ gridArea: '1 / 1 / 2 / 3' }} className={`${T} react-select__input-container css-19bb58m`} data-value="">
            <input className={`${T} react-select__input`} autoComplete="off" spellCheck="false" disabled={disabled}
                   type="text" role="combobox" aria-expanded={open} aria-haspopup="true" readOnly value="" style={{ width: 2, border: 0, padding: 0, outline: 0 }} />
          </div>
        </div>
        <div style={{ width: 34, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', flexShrink: 0 }}
             className={`${T} react-select__indicators css-1wy0on6`}>
          <div className={`${T} react-select__indicator ${T} react-select__dropdown-indicator ${indicatorCls}`} aria-hidden="true">
            <svg className="transition-transform duration-200" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20px" height="20px" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none">
              <path fillRule="evenodd" clipRule="evenodd" d="M11.9999 13.9394L17.4696 8.46973L18.5303 9.53039L11.9999 16.0607L5.46961 9.53039L6.53027 8.46973L11.9999 13.9394Z" fill="#ccc" />
            </svg>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      {open && (
        <div style={{ ...menuBox, background: '#fff', borderRadius: 4, boxShadow: '0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.1), 0 4px 11px rgba(0,0,0,.1)' }}
             className={`${T} react-select__menu css-1nmdiq5-menu`}>
          <div style={{ maxHeight: 200, overflowY: 'auto', padding: '4px 0' }} className={`${T} react-select__menu-list css-qr46ko`}>
            {options.map((o) => {
              // { heading } = a group title inside the menu (NEW: no captured react-select group heading; DIVERGES: plain small grey label)
              if (o && typeof o === 'object' && o.heading) return <div key={'h-' + o.heading} style={{ padding: '8px 12px 4px', fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600, color: '#667085', textTransform: 'uppercase', cursor: 'default' }}>{o.heading}</div>
              const selected = o === value
              return (
                <div key={o} onClick={() => { onChange?.(o); setOpen(false) }} style={{ padding: '8px 12px', cursor: 'pointer', background: selected ? (colors ? 'rgb(68, 76, 231)' : '#f3f4f6') : undefined,
                  ...(colors ? { display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, color: selected ? '#fff' : 'rgb(16, 24, 40)', fontWeight: selected ? 500 : 400 } : {}) }}
                     className={selected
                       ? `${T} react-select__option ${T} react-select__option--is-focused ${T} react-select__option--is-selected css-ts4ox6-option`
                       : `${T} react-select__option css-1lmhnew-option`}>{colors?.[o] && <span style={{ width: 10, height: 10, borderRadius: 9999, background: colors[o], flexShrink: 0 }} />}{o}</div>
              )
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

// Searchable multi-select (FIX-LIST 11: pick members out of 200 people). COPIED: the multi-value control of
// modules/recruitment/dom/yopmail_rc_jobs_add_full.html (react-select__value-container--is-multi, __multi-value / __label / __remove with
// their css-* hashes, the real input). Typing filters the menu; a picked option becomes a chip and the menu closes (react-select's
// closeMenuOnSelect); typing or clicking the box opens it again; ✕ on a chip removes it.
// The emotion CSS is not in the DOM → chip / menu box drawn with inline style (react-select's default values), as in Select above.
export function MultiSelect({ values = [], options, onChange, placeholder = 'Search and select', id = 40, width = '100%' }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  const [q, setQ] = useState('')
  const ref = useRef(null)
  const input = useRef(null)
  const menuBox2 = useMenuBox(ref, open, setOpen, values.length)
  useEffect(() => {
    const h = (e) => { if (ref.current && !ref.current.contains(e.target)) setOpen(false) }
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', h, true)
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', h, true)
  }, [])
  const left = options.filter((o) => !values.includes(o) && o.toLowerCase().includes(q.trim().toLowerCase()))
  return (
    <div ref={ref} style={{ position: 'relative', width }} className={`${T} css-b62m3t-container`}>
      <span id={`react-select-${id}-live-region`} className="css-7pg0cj-a11yText" />
      <div onClick={() => { setOpen(true); input.current?.focus() }} style={{ ...CONTROL['css-1d2ikgd-control'], height: 'auto', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', cursor: 'text' }}
           className={`${T} react-select__control css-1d2ikgd-control`}>
        <div style={{ padding: '2px 8px', display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 2, flex: 1 }}
             className={`${T} react-select__value-container ${T} react-select__value-container--is-multi ${T} react-select__value-container--has-value css-1dyz3mf`}>
          {values.map((v) => (
            <div key={v} style={{ display: 'flex', background: 'rgb(230, 230, 230)', borderRadius: 2, margin: 2 }} className={`${T} react-select__multi-value css-atpve2`}>
              <div style={{ padding: '3px 3px 3px 6px', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }} className={`${T} react-select__multi-value__label css-9jq23d`}>{v}</div>
              <div role="button" aria-label={`Remove ${v}`} onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); onChange(values.filter((x) => x !== v)) }}
                   style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', padding: '0 4px', cursor: 'pointer' }} className={`${T} react-select__multi-value__remove css-v7duua`}>
                <svg height="14" width="14" viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="M14.348 14.849c-0.469 0.469-1.229 0.469-1.697 0l-2.651-3.030-2.651 3.029c-0.469 0.469-1.229 0.469-1.697 0-0.469-0.469-0.469-1.229 0-1.697l2.758-3.15-2.759-3.152c-0.469-0.469-0.469-1.228 0-1.697s1.228-0.469 1.697 0l2.652 3.031 2.651-3.031c0.469-0.469 1.228-0.469 1.697 0s0.469 1.229 0 1.697l-2.758 3.152 2.758 3.15c0.469 0.469 0.469 1.229 0 1.698z" fill="currentColor" /></svg>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
          <div className={`${T} react-select__input-container css-19bb58m`} data-value={q} style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 60 }}>
            <input ref={input} className={`${T} react-select__input`} autoComplete="off" spellCheck="false" type="text" role="combobox" aria-expanded={open} aria-haspopup="true"
                   value={q} placeholder={values.length ? '' : placeholder} onChange={(e) => { setQ(e.target.value); setOpen(true) }} onFocus={() => setOpen(true)}
                   onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Backspace' && !q && values.length) onChange(values.slice(0, -1)); if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); if (left[0]) { onChange([...values, left[0]]); setQ(''); setOpen(false) } } }}
                   style={{ width: '100%', border: 0, padding: '6px 0', outline: 0, background: 'transparent' }} />
          </div>
        </div>
        <div style={{ width: 34, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', flexShrink: 0 }} className={`${T} react-select__indicators css-1wy0on6`}>
          <div className={`${T} react-select__indicator ${T} react-select__dropdown-indicator css-1xc3v61-indicatorContainer`} aria-hidden="true">
            <svg className="transition-transform duration-200" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20px" height="20px" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none">
              <path fillRule="evenodd" clipRule="evenodd" d="M11.9999 13.9394L17.4696 8.46973L18.5303 9.53039L11.9999 16.0607L5.46961 9.53039L6.53027 8.46973L11.9999 13.9394Z" fill="#ccc" />
            </svg>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      {open && (
        <div style={{ ...menuBox2, background: '#fff', borderRadius: 4, boxShadow: '0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.1), 0 4px 11px rgba(0,0,0,.1)' }}
             className={`${T} react-select__menu css-1nmdiq5-menu`}>
          <div style={{ maxHeight: 200, overflowY: 'auto', padding: '4px 0' }} className={`${T} react-select__menu-list css-qr46ko`}>
            {left.length === 0 && <div style={{ padding: '8px 12px', color: '#999' }} className={`${T} react-select__option css-1lmhnew-option`}>No options</div>}
            {left.map((o) => (
              <div key={o} onMouseDown={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); onChange([...values, o]); setQ(''); setOpen(false) }} style={{ padding: '8px 12px', cursor: 'pointer' }}
                   className={`${T} react-select__option css-1lmhnew-option`}>{o}</div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

export function PeopleMultiSelect({ values = [], options, onChange, placeholder = 'Select', id = 40, width = '100%' }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  const [q, setQ] = useState('')
  const ref = useRef(null)
  const panel = useRef(null)
  const menuBox = useMenuBox(ref, open, setOpen)
  useEffect(() => {
    const h = (e) => { if (ref.current && !ref.current.contains(e.target) && !(panel.current && panel.current.contains(e.target))) setOpen(false) }
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', h, true)
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', h, true)
  }, [])
  const shown = options.filter((o) => o.toLowerCase().includes(q.trim().toLowerCase()))
  const toggle = (o) => onChange(values.includes(o) ? values.filter((x) => x !== o) : options.filter((x) => x === o || values.includes(x)))
  const filled = values.length > 0
  return (
    <div ref={ref} onClick={() => setOpen((v) => !v)} title={values.join(', ')}

      </div>
      <div className="p-multiselect-label-container" style={{ overflow: 'hidden', flex: '1 1 auto', minWidth: 0 }}>
        <div className={`p-multiselect-label${filled ? '' : ' p-placeholder'}`} style={{ display: 'block', whiteSpace: 'nowrap', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', padding: '3.2px 8px', color: filled ? '#000' : '#667085' }}>
          {filled ? values.map((v) => (
            <div key={v} className="p-multiselect-token cursor-pointer !text-xs !h-6 !my-0 !p-0" style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', verticalAlign: 'middle', marginRight: 4, padding: '2px 3px 2px 6px', borderRadius: 16, background: 'rgb(229, 231, 235)', color: 'rgb(75, 85, 99)', lineHeight: '16px', maxWidth: 103 }}>

                onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); onChange(values.filter((x) => x !== v)) }} />
            </div>
          )) : placeholder}

      {filled && (

          style={{ width: 10, height: 10, flexShrink: 0, cursor: 'pointer' }} onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); onChange([]) }}><path d={MS_X} fill="currentColor" /></svg>
      )}
      <div className="p-multiselect-trigger" style={{ width: 36, height: 30, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', flexShrink: 0 }}>
        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20px" height="20px" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" className={`transition-transform duration-200 ease-[cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1)] ${open ? 'rotate-180' : 'rotate-0'}`}>
          <path fillRule="evenodd" clipRule="evenodd" d="M11.9999 13.9394L17.4696 8.46973L18.5303 9.53039L11.9999 16.0607L5.46961 9.53039L6.53027 8.46973L11.9999 13.9394Z" fill={open ? '#444CE7' : '#ccc'} />
        </svg>
      </div>
      {open && (
        <div ref={panel} onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} className="p-multiselect-panel p-component p-ripple-disabled p-connected-overlay-enter-done"
          style={{ ...menuBox, minWidth: 210, background: '#fff', border: '1px solid rgb(209, 213, 219)', borderRadius: 6, boxShadow: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) 0px 2px 12px 0px', color: 'rgb(75, 85, 99)', cursor: 'default' }}>

              <div className="custom-input-wrapper" style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
                <input className="custom-filter-input custom-input-text custom-component" type="text" role="searchbox" autoFocus value={q} onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)}
                  style={{ width: '100%', height: 30, padding: '0 30px 0 10px', border: '1px solid rgb(209, 213, 219)', borderRadius: 6, fontSize: 12, color: 'rgb(55, 65, 81)', outline: 0 }} />
                <span className="custom-filter-icon-wrapper" style={{ position: 'absolute', right: 8, top: 3 }}><span className="icon-search-md text-md w-[14px] h-[14px]" /></span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <button type="button" className="p-multiselect-close p-link" aria-label="Close" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}
              style={{ width: 32, height: 32, borderRadius: '50%', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', flexShrink: 0, color: 'rgb(55, 65, 81)' }}>
              <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 14 14" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" className="p-icon p-multiselect-close-icon" aria-hidden="true"><path d={MS_X} fill="currentColor" /></svg>
            </button>
          </div>
          <div className="p-multiselect-items-wrapper" style={{ maxHeight: 245, overflow: 'auto' }}>
            <ul className="p-multiselect-items p-component" role="listbox" aria-multiselectable="true" id={`pr_id_${id}-multi-selectbox`} style={{ margin: 0, padding: 0, listStyle: 'none' }}>
              {shown.map((o) => { const on = values.includes(o); return (
                <li key={o} className={`p-multiselect-item${on ? ' p-highlight' : ''}`} role="option" aria-selected={on} onClick={() => toggle(o)}
                  style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', cursor: 'pointer', padding: '5px 8px', minHeight: 42, backgroundColor: on ? 'rgb(238, 244, 255)' : 'rgb(255, 255, 255)', color: 'black', fontSize: 14 }}>
                  {/* the real PrimeReact checkbox sits here but is hidden by its theme; the visible box is the real tick-checkbox below */}
                  <div className="p-multiselect-checkbox" style={{ display: 'none' }} />
                  <span><div className="!flex !items-center"><div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <input type="checkbox" className={MS_TICK} readOnly checked={on} /><div className="flex flex-col" />
                  </div><p className="!break-words !whitespace-normal !text-left 2xl:text-sm 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs" style={{ marginLeft: 8 }}>{o}</p></div></span>
                </li>) })}
              {shown.length === 0 && <li className="p-multiselect-item" style={{ padding: '8px 12px', color: '#999', fontSize: 12 }}>No results found</li>}
            </ul>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

//   modules/super-admin/dom/yop_tabs_group3_hover_2026-11-18.html
import { TL } from '../data/tabsLive.js'

function sameList(a, b) {
  if (!Array.isArray(a) || !Array.isArray(b) || a.length !== b.length) return false
  return a.every((v, i) => String(v) === String(b[i]))
}

function parseHTML(html) {
  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return null
  const tpl = document.createElement('template')
  tpl.innerHTML = html
  return tpl.content
}

function itemsOf(container, rtype) {
  const kids = Array.from(container.children || [])
  if (rtype === 'config-list') return kids.filter((k) => k.tagName.toLowerCase() === 'a')
  if (rtype === 'icon-toggle') return kids.filter((k) => k.tagName.toLowerCase() === 'span' && /icon-/.test(k.className || ''))
  if (rtype === 'pill-switch' || rtype === 'pill-anim' || rtype === 'pill' || rtype === 'trans-parent')
    return kids.filter((k) => k.tagName.toLowerCase() === 'button')
  return kids.filter((k) => {
    const cls = k.className || ''
    if (k.tagName.toLowerCase() === 'div' && /absolute/.test(cls) && /transition/.test(cls) && /bg-/.test(cls)) return false
    return ['a', 'button', 'div', 'span', 'li'].includes(k.tagName.toLowerCase())
  })
}

function setLabel(el, text) {
  const label = String(text)
  const p = el.querySelector('p')
  if (p && !p.querySelector('[class*="icon-"]')) { p.textContent = label; return }
  for (const node of Array.from(el.childNodes)) {
    if (node.nodeType === 3 && node.textContent.trim()) { node.textContent = label; return }
  }
  const span = Array.from(el.children).find((c) => c.tagName.toLowerCase() === 'span' && !/icon-|rounded|border|badge/.test(c.className || '') && !c.children.length)
  if (span) { span.textContent = label; return }
  if (!el.children.length) { el.textContent = label; return }
  // Keep badge children: replace only the first text-bearing leaf
  for (const leaf of el.querySelectorAll('span,p')) { if (!leaf.children.length && leaf.textContent.trim() && !/^\d+$/.test(leaf.textContent.trim())) { leaf.textContent = label; return } }
}

function setCount(el, n) {
  const badge = Array.from(el.querySelectorAll('span,div')).find((x) => /rounded-2xl|badge/.test(x.className || '') && /^\d+$/.test(x.textContent.trim().replace(/[()]/g, '')))
  if (badge) { badge.textContent = String(n); return }
}

export function Tabs({ group = 1, state = 'default', activeIndex, tabs, counts, showCountBadges, disabledIndices }) {
  const g = TL[`group${group}`] || TL.group1
  const cells = g.cells || {}
  const st = cells[state] ? state : (cells.default ? 'default' : Object.keys(cells)[0])
  const cell = cells[st]
  if (!cell || !cell.outer) return null
  const capAct = cell.activeIndex ?? 0
  const capLabels = cell.labels || []
  const capCounts = cell.counts || null

  // If the props already equal what was captured, render the captured markup verbatim (no re-serialisation).
  const actSame = activeIndex == null || activeIndex === capAct
  const labelsSame = !tabs || !tabs.length || sameList(tabs, capLabels)
  const countsSame = !counts || !counts.length || (capCounts && sameList(counts, capCounts))
  if (actSame && labelsSame && countsSame) {
    return <div style={{ display: 'contents' }} dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: cell.outer }} />
  }

  const frag = parseHTML(cell.outer)
  const container = frag && frag.firstElementChild
  if (!container) return <div style={{ display: 'contents' }} dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: cell.outer }} />
  const items = itemsOf(container, cell.rtype)
  const useIdx = activeIndex != null ? activeIndex : capAct
  items.forEach((el, i) => {
    const cls = i === useIdx ? (g.activeClass || el.getAttribute('class')) : (g.inactiveClass || el.getAttribute('class'))
    if (cls) el.setAttribute('class', cls)
    const tag = el.tagName.toLowerCase()
    if (tag === 'a') { if (i === useIdx) el.setAttribute('aria-current', 'page'); else el.removeAttribute('aria-current') }
    else if (tag === 'button' || el.getAttribute('role') === 'tab') el.setAttribute('aria-selected', i === useIdx ? 'true' : 'false')
    if (tag === 'button' && disabledIndices && disabledIndices.includes(i)) { el.setAttribute('disabled', 'true'); el.setAttribute('aria-disabled', 'true') }
    if (tabs && tabs[i] != null && !sameList([tabs[i]], [capLabels[i]])) setLabel(el, tabs[i])
    if (counts && counts[i] != null && (!capCounts || String(counts[i]) !== String(capCounts[i]))) setCount(el, counts[i])
  })
  return <div style={{ display: 'contents' }} dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: container.outerHTML }} />
}

export const LIVE_TAB_GROUPS = Object.keys(TL).filter((k) => k.startsWith('group')).map((k) => parseInt(k.replace('group', ''), 10))

// The Open | Closed | Cancelled tab strip of modules/super-admin/dom/support_tickets.html, extended to N tabs.
// Exact strings from the capture: selected = `rounded-lg overflow-hidden text-white bg-indigo-700 <shape>`; unselected end tabs keep rounded-lg,
// the unselected middle tab drops it (`rounded-none`).
// DIVERGES: unselected FIRST tab and selected MIDDLE/LAST tab — the capture has 3 tabs; these combinations have no exact string, real pieces recombined.
const TAB = 'tab-transition font-semibold relative z-[20] whitespace-nowrap px-3.5 w-fit 2xl:text-sm 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs text-center'
const cls = (on, first, last) => {
  const shape = first ? 'rounded-r-none' : last ? 'rounded-l-none' : 'rounded-none'
  if (on) return `${TAB} rounded-lg overflow-hidden text-white bg-indigo-700 ${shape} border-r py-2 active`
  return `${TAB} ${first || last ? 'rounded-lg ' : ''}overflow-hidden hover:text-white hover:bg-indigo-700 text-gray-500 ${shape} border-r py-2 active`
}

// tabs = [{ key, label }]
export default function TabStrip({ tabs, active, onChange }) {
  return (
    <div className="z-1"><div className="block"><div>
      <nav aria-label="Tabs" className="tab flex items-center relative overflow-auto rounded-lg border">
        {tabs.map((t, i) => (
          <a key={t.key} aria-current="page" onClick={() => onChange(t.key)} className={cls(t.key === active, i === 0, i === tabs.length - 1)}>{t.label}</a>
        ))}
      </nav>
    </div></div></div>
  )
}

// Working pagination (same copied classes as Pagination above)
export function PagedFooter({ page, pages, onPage }) {
  const start = Math.max(1, Math.min(page - 2, pages - 4))
  const nums = Array.from({ length: Math.min(5, pages) }, (_, i) => start + i)
  return (
    <div className="bg-white 2xl:p-4 2xl-to-xl:p-2 p-2 border border-t-0 rounded-b-md responsive-dropdown">
      <div className="flex space-x-2 justify-between">
        <div className="flex justify-center items-center gap-3">
          <p className="text-gray-700 2xl:text-sm 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs font-medium">Page {page} of {pages}</p>
        </div>
        <nav className="isolate inline-flex -space-x-px rounded-md shadow-sm" aria-label="Pagination">
          <button disabled={page <= 1} onClick={() => onPage(page - 1)} className="rounded-l-lg inline-flex items-center disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50 px-4 2xl:py-2.5 2xl-to-xl:py-1 py-1 2xl:text-sm 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs font-semibold ring-1 ring-inset ring-gray-300 focus:z-20 focus:outline-offset-0">
            <span className="icon-arrow-narrow-left text-xl me-2" /><span className="sm:block hidden">Previous</span>
          </button>
          {nums.map((n) => <button key={n} onClick={() => onPage(n)} className={n === page ? PAGE_ACTIVE : PAGE_IDLE}>{n}</button>)}
          <button disabled={page >= pages} onClick={() => onPage(page + 1)} className="rounded-r-lg relative inline-flex items-center disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50 px-4 2xl:py-2.5 2xl-to-xl:py-1 py-1 2xl:text-sm 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs font-semibold ring-1 ring-inset ring-gray-300 focus:z-20 focus:outline-offset-0">
            <span className="sm:block hidden">Next</span><span className="icon-arrow-narrow-right text-xl ms-2" />
          </button>
        </nav>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

const CHEVRON = (
  <svg className="transition-transform duration-200" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20px" height="20px" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none">
    <path fillRule="evenodd" clipRule="evenodd" d="M11.9999 13.9394L17.4696 8.46973L18.5303 9.53039L11.9999 16.0607L5.46961 9.53039L6.53027 8.46973L11.9999 13.9394Z" fill="#ccc" />

// Multi-select — same react-select control and menu classes as Select above (copied from the captured DOM),
// with a checkbox per option so any number of values can be picked; the clear "x" empties it.
export function MultiSelect({ placeholder = 'Select', options, value = [], onChange, className = '' }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  const [hover, setHover] = useState(null)
  const ref = useRef(null)
  useEffect(() => {
    const close = (e) => ref.current && !ref.current.contains(e.target) && setOpen(false)
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', close)
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', close)
  }, [])
  const toggle = (v) => onChange(value.includes(v) ? value.filter((x) => x !== v) : [...value, v])
  const label = value.length === 0 ? null : value.length === 1 ? options.find((o) => o.value === value[0])?.label : `${value.length} selected`
  return (
    <div ref={ref} className={`${className} 2xl:text-sm 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs css-b62m3t-container`}>
      <div onClick={() => setOpen(!open)} className={`2xl:text-sm 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs react-select__control ${open ? 'css-tpvs3e-control' : 'css-1d2ikgd-control'}`}>
        <div className="2xl:text-sm 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs react-select__value-container css-hlgwow">
          {label
            ? <div className="2xl:text-sm 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs react-select__single-value css-1dimb5e-singleValue">{label}</div>
            : <div className="2xl:text-sm 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs react-select__placeholder css-1jqq78o-placeholder">{placeholder}</div>}
        </div>
        <div className="2xl:text-sm 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs react-select__indicators css-1wy0on6">
          {value.length > 0 && (
            <div onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); onChange([]) }} className="2xl:text-sm 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs react-select__indicator css-1xc3v61-indicatorContainer">
              <span className="icon-x-close text-base" />
            </div>
          )}
          <div className={`2xl:text-sm 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs react-select__indicator react-select__dropdown-indicator ${open ? 'css-15lsz6c-indicatorContainer' : 'css-1xc3v61-indicatorContainer'}`} aria-hidden="true">{CHEVRON}</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      {open && (
        <div className="2xl:text-sm 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs react-select__menu css-1nmdiq5-menu">
          <div className="2xl:text-sm 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs react-select__menu-list css-qr46ko" role="listbox">
            {options.map((o, i) => (
              <div key={o.value} role="option" aria-selected={value.includes(o.value)} onMouseEnter={() => setHover(i)} onClick={() => toggle(o.value)}
                className={hover === i
                  ? '2xl:text-sm 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs react-select__option react-select__option--is-focused css-1tfqtj-option flex items-center gap-x-2'
                  : '2xl:text-sm 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs react-select__option css-1lmhnew-option flex items-center gap-x-2'}>
                <input type="checkbox" readOnly checked={value.includes(o.value)} className="accent-indigo-600 pointer-events-none align-middle" /><span className="ml-2 align-middle">{o.label}</span>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

// Segmented toggle — COPIED: the Self / Organization toggle, admin/dom/my_todo_job_interviews.html (TOGGLE_ON /
// TOGGLE_OFF are the captured class sets). The first button keeps rounded-l-lg, the last rounded-r-lg. INVENTED: more
// than two buttons — the inner ones have no rounding and overlap by one pixel (-ml-px) so borders never double.
const TOGGLE_ON = 'px-4 font-semibold border bg-indigo-600 text-white border-indigo-600 2xl:py-1.5 2xl-to-xl:py-1 py-1 2xl:h-auto 2xl-to-xl:h-7 h-7 flex items-center'
const TOGGLE_OFF = 'px-4 font-semibold border-gray-300 text-gray-700 border 2xl:py-1.5 2xl-to-xl:py-1 py-1 2xl:h-auto 2xl-to-xl:h-7 h-7 flex items-center'
export function SegmentToggle({ value, onChange, options }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center shrink-0">
      {options.map(([key, label], i) => (
        <button key={key} type="button" onClick={() => onChange(key)}
          className={`${value === key ? TOGGLE_ON + ' relative z-[1]' : TOGGLE_OFF + ' bg-white'} ${i === 0 ? 'rounded-l-lg' : '-ml-px'} ${i === options.length - 1 ? 'rounded-r-lg' : ''}`}>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-x-2 2xl:text-sm 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs font-semibold whitespace-nowrap">{label}</div>
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}

// COPIED: customers_list.html — breadcrumb
export function Breadcrumb({ items }) {
  return (
    <nav className="flex border-b border-gray-200 py-2 bg-white items-center justify-between px-4" aria-label="Breadcrumb">
      <ol className="flex items-center space-x-2 overflow-x-auto flex-nowrap no-scrollbar scrollbar-hide sm:flex-wrap">
        <li>
          <div>
            <Link className="hover:text-gray-700 text-gray-500 sm:whitespace-normal whitespace-nowrap" to="/dashboard">
              <span className="icon-home-line flex-shrink-0 text-lg flex" />
            </Link>
          </div>
        </li>
        {items.map((it, i) => (
          <li key={i}>
            <div className="flex items-center">
              <span className="icon-chevron-right flex-shrink-0 text-base text-gray-300" />
              {i === items.length - 1
                ? <span className="text-indigo-700 cursor-default pointer-events-none ml-4 2xl:text-sm 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs font-medium sm:whitespace-normal whitespace-nowrap" aria-current="page">{it.label}</span>
                : <Link className="text-gray-600 cursor-pointer hover:text-gray-800 ml-4 2xl:text-sm 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs font-medium sm:whitespace-normal whitespace-nowrap" to={it.to}>{it.label}</Link>}
            </div>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ol>
    </nav>
  )
}

// an action button: the real "Submit Now" button (People › Config: grey outline, turns indigo-600 + white on hover) + an icon-*
// ⋮ menu — COPIED from Project Management's checklist "More Options" menu (modules/project-mgmt/api/convert_to_ticket_code_2026-10-06.json):
// trigger span, menu box and item strings are verbatim. DIVERGES: the real menu is portalled with computed top/left; here it opens under the button.
export function MoreActions({ items }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false); const box = useRef(null)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return undefined
    const out = (e) => { if (box.current && !box.current.contains(e.target)) setOpen(false) }
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', out); return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', out)
  }, [open])
  return (
    <div ref={box} style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
      <span title="More Options" onClick={() => setOpen((x) => !x)} className="icon-dots-vertical 2xl:text-base 2xl-to-xl:text-sm text-sm p-1.5 rounded-lg inline-flex justify-center items-center overflow-hidden cursor-pointer transition-colors duration-150 border bg-white text-gray-500 shadow-[0px_1px_2px_0px_rgba(16,24,40,0.05)] hover:!bg-gray-50" />
      {open && (
        <div style={{ position: 'absolute', top: '100%', right: 0, marginTop: 4, minWidth: 200 }} className="z-[1000] bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-100 shadow-[0px_12px_24px_-6px_rgba(16,24,40,0.14),0px_4px_8px_-2px_rgba(16,24,40,0.08)] p-1.5">
          {items.map(([icon, label, go]) => (
            <button key={label} type="button" onClick={() => { setOpen(false); go() }} className="w-full flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-2 text-left text-gray-700 hover:!bg-gray-50 transition-colors duration-100">
              <span className={`icon-${icon} text-base text-gray-500`} /><span className="text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap">{label}</span>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

// Assign / Reassign modal. Shell = cc/Modal (copied), the person field = cc/Field SelectField + Select (copied); every class string comes from
// those primitives. Moved from prototypes/helpdesk-ticketing/src/components/super/AssignModal.jsx (18 Nov 2026), made general: no ticket data.
// Capture of the Select control string css-1d2ikgd-control: modules/admin/dom/helpdesk_add_ticket_drawer_2026-10-05.html.
// options = ['Jason Doe · 3 open', …]   reasonLabel = ask for a reason too (Reassign)   onConfirm(option, reason)
import { useState } from 'react'
import Modal from './Modal.jsx'
import { SelectField, Textarea } from './Field.jsx'
import Select from '../Select.jsx'

export default function AssignModal({ title = 'Assign', label = 'Assign To', options, confirmLabel = 'Assign', reasonLabel, onConfirm, onClose }) {
  const [pick, setPick] = useState('')
  const [why, setWhy] = useState('')
  const go = () => { if (!pick) return; onConfirm(pick, why.trim()); onClose() }
  return (
    <Modal title={title} onClose={onClose} onConfirm={go} confirmLabel={confirmLabel} confirmDisabled={!pick || (reasonLabel && !why.trim())}>
      <SelectField label={label} required>
        <Select value={pick} options={options} placeholder="Select" onChange={setPick} width="100%" controlCls="css-1d2ikgd-control" id={20} />
      </SelectField>
      {reasonLabel && <div className="mt-4"><Textarea label={reasonLabel} required rows={3} value={why} onChange={(e) => setWhy(e.target.value)} /></div>}
    </Modal>
  )
}


=== FILE: src/components/cc/Avatar.jsx ===
// COPIED from the initials avatar in modules/super-admin/dom/users_list.html. Background is an inline rgb(), as in the real DOM:
// the three captured colours are blue rgb(21,112,239), green rgb(7,148,85), orange rgb(220,104,3). Picked by the name so it stays stable.
const COLORS = ['rgb(21, 112, 239)', 'rgb(7, 148, 85)', 'rgb(220, 104, 3)']

export const initials = (name = '') => name.trim().split(/\s+/).slice(0, 2).map((w) => w[0]?.toUpperCase() || '').join('')

export default function Avatar({ name }) {
  const sum = [...name].reduce((a, c) => a + c.charCodeAt(0), 0)
  return (
    <div className="2xl:size-[50px] 2xl-to-xl:size-9 size-9 border text-white select-none rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mb-2 text-gray-900 font-medium 2xl:text-md text-xs"
      style={{ backgroundColor: COLORS[sum % COLORS.length] }}>{initials(name)}</div>
  )
}

// COPIED from the ticket drawer header of modules/people/dom/rsp_tabs_support_ticket_view_01_view_request_2026-09-25.html: a photo in a round wrapper
// (`rounded-full overflow-hidden 2xl:size-12 2xl-to-xl:size-10 size-10` + `<img class="rounded-full object-cover …">`; `size-4` for the Assigned To pill).
// There are no photos in the seed, so the image is a generated initials SVG with the same three captured colours as Avatar above.
// initials picture as a data URL (the real app shows a photo here; we have none)
export function avatarSrc(name = '') {
  const sum = [...name].reduce((a, c) => a + c.charCodeAt(0), 0)
  const svg = `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="48" height="48"><rect width="48" height="48" fill="${COLORS[sum % COLORS.length]}"/><text x="24" y="31" font-family="Inter,Arial,sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="500" fill="#fff" text-anchor="middle">${initials(name)}</text></svg>`
  return `data:image/svg+xml;utf8,${encodeURIComponent(svg)}`
}

export function AvatarImg({ name = '', small = false }) {
  const src = avatarSrc(name)
  return small
    ? <div className="rounded-full overflow-hidden size-4"><img src={src} className="rounded-full object-cover size-4" alt={name} title={name} /></div>
    : <div className="rounded-full overflow-hidden 2xl:size-12 2xl-to-xl:size-10 size-10"><img src={src} className="rounded-full object-cover 2xl:size-12 2xl-to-xl:size-10 size-10" alt={name} title={name} /></div>
}

      {options.map((o) => {

            {label}
          </button>
        )

    </div>
  )
}

const pageList = (page, pages) => {
  if (pages <= 7) return Array.from({ length: pages }, (_, i) => i + 1)
  const s = new Set([1, 2, 3, 4, pages - 1, pages, page - 1, page, page + 1].filter((n) => n >= 1 && n <= pages))
  const out = []; let prev = 0
  ;[...s].sort((a, b) => a - b).forEach((n) => { if (n - prev > 1) out.push('…'); out.push(n); prev = n })
  return out
}

                      <div className="">
                        {c.sortable ? (
                          <div className="flex">
                            <span className="self-center">{c.label}</span>
                            <div className="flex items-center"><span className={sort?.key === c.key ? `text-gray-600 text-base ${sort.desc ? 'icon-arrow-narrow-down' : 'icon-arrow-narrow-up'} ml-1` : 'text-gray-300 text-base icon-sort ml-1'} /></div>
                          </div>
                        ) : c.label}

                      <div className="">Action</div>

=== FILE: src/components/cc/FilterBar.jsx ===
// The list filter bar of People › Employees / Exit Management (FIX-LIST R2). COPIED, class strings verbatim, from
//   modules/admin/dom/helpdesk_help_menu_2026-10-05.html (the bar closed: "Filter Results..." + field menu + "Filter")
//   modules/people/dom/filterbar_last_working_date_03_field_picked / 05_next2_2026-09-25.html (a chip being built: field token, "Is" token, open menus)
// A chip = one grey box per part ("Status" · "Is not" · "Closed"), each part a white token. Menus are the real <ul>/<li> strings
// (highlighted item = `… bg-gray-100`). The ✕ in the w-8 box clears every chip; "Filter" applies the chips.
// NOT BUILT: the Σ select left of the bar (match all / any) — its options are not captured.
// DIVERGES: the per-chip ✕ is the real ✕ of the Deal Details tag chip (crm-invoice deals_id_details) — the captured bar only has clear-all.
// Logic: chips on the same field with "Is" are OR'ed, "Is not" chips all exclude; different fields are AND'ed. Typed text that is not a field
// LOOKUP ONLY (BA, 5 Oct): every field and every value is picked from a list. Typing only narrows the open list; Enter picks the top
// item. There is no free-text value — EXCEPT (BA 6 Oct) a field that lists 'Contains' in its own `ops` (Ticket ID, Subject): after
// Contains, whatever is typed becomes the value (Enter, or the 'Contains "…"' item); a field's `ops` default to Is / Is not.
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'

const UL = 'absolute z-10 mt-2.5 left-0 rounded-md bg-white py-2 shadow-lg ring-1 ring-gray-900/5 focus:outline-none max-h-[300px] overflow-y-auto'
const LI = 'cursor-pointer 2xl:min-w-[260px] 2xl-to-xl:min-w-[200px] min-w-[200px] 2xl:text-sm 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs font-medium whitespace-nowrap 2xl:px-3 2xl-to-xl:px-2.5 px-2.5 2xl:py-2 2xl-to-xl:py-1.5 py-1.5'
const TOKEN = '2xl:text-sm 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs border border-gray-300 rounded py-0.5 px-1.5 bg-white text-gray-700 font-medium w-max'
const ICON = (i) => `icon-${i} text-gray-600 2xl:text-lg 2xl-to-xl:text-base text-base pe-2`
export const OPS = ['Is', 'Is not']

// one grey part box with its token (+ its own menu while open)
const Part = ({ children, menu }) => (
  <div className="w-max">
    <div className="w-full h-full flex items-start"><div className="flex items-center p-1 gap-0.5 bg-gray-100 rounded-md"><div className={TOKEN}>{children}</div></div></div>
    <div className="transition-opacity duration-500 scale-0 opacity-0">{menu}</div>
  </div>
)
const FieldName = ({ f }) => <span><div className="flex items-center"><span className={ICON(f.icon)} /><span>{f.label}</span></div></span>

export function matchChips(chips, fields, row) {
  const byField = {}
  chips.forEach((c) => { (byField[c.field] = byField[c.field] || []).push(c) })
  return Object.entries(byField).every(([key, cs]) => {
    const field = fields.find((f) => f.key === key); const v = field.get(row)
    const is = cs.filter((c) => c.op === 'Is').map((c) => c.value)
    const has = cs.filter((c) => c.op === 'Contains').map((c) => c.value.toLowerCase())
    const not = cs.filter((c) => c.op === 'Is not').map((c) => c.value)
    const pos = is.length || has.length ? is.includes(v) || has.some((h) => String(v ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(h)) : true   // Is / Contains are OR'ed
    return pos && !not.includes(v)
  })
}

export default function FilterBar({ fields, chips, onApply }) {
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState(chips)
  const [stage, setStage] = useState(null)          // null · { field } (pick op) · { field, op } (pick value)
  const [text, setText] = useState('')
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  const box = useRef(null)
  useEffect(() => setDraft(chips), [chips])
  useEffect(() => {
    const off = (e) => { if (box.current && !box.current.contains(e.target)) { setOpen(false); setStage(null) } }
    // capture phase: runs BEFORE React re-renders the menu (a picked item is removed from the DOM at once, so a bubbling
    // listener would see a detached target, treat it as an outside click and reset the bar — the "can't click the filter" bug)
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', off, true); return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', off, true)
  }, [])

  const fieldOf = (k) => fields.find((f) => f.key === k)
  const add = (chip) => { const next = [...draft, chip]; setDraft(next); setStage(null); setText(''); setOpen(false); onApply(next) }
  const remove = (i) => { const next = draft.filter((_, j) => j !== i); setDraft(next); onApply(next) }
  const shownFields = fields.filter((f) => f.label.toLowerCase().includes(text.trim().toLowerCase()))
  const q = text.trim().toLowerCase()
  const opsShown = (stage ? fieldOf(stage.field).ops || OPS : OPS).filter((o) => o.toLowerCase().includes(q))
  const free = stage?.op === 'Contains' && text.trim()
  const valuesShown = stage?.op ? fieldOf(stage.field).options.filter((o) => o.toLowerCase().includes(q)) : []
  const pickField = (f) => { setStage({ field: f.key }); setText('') }
  const pickOp = (o) => { setStage({ ...stage, op: o }); setText('') }
  const onKey = (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'Backspace' && !text && stage) { setStage(stage.op ? { field: stage.field } : null); return }
    if (e.key !== 'Enter') return
    e.preventDefault()                                     // Enter = the first item of the open list, never the typed text
    if (!stage) { if (shownFields[0]) pickField(shownFields[0]) }
    else if (!stage.op) { if (opsShown[0]) pickOp(opsShown[0]) }
    else if (free) add({ ...stage, value: text.trim() })
    else if (valuesShown[0]) add({ ...stage, value: valuesShown[0] })
  }

  // closed = the field list stays in the DOM, hidden by `scale-0 opacity-0` (as in the capture); open = the same wrapper with `opacity-100 scale-100`
  const none = <li className={LI}><span>No matching option</span></li>
  const fieldMenu = <ul className={UL}>{shownFields.length ? shownFields.map((f) => <li key={f.key} className={LI} onMouseDown={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); pickField(f) }}><FieldName f={f} /></li>) : none}</ul>
  let menu = null
  if (open && !stage) menu = fieldMenu
  else if (open && !stage.op) menu = <ul className={UL}>{opsShown.length ? opsShown.map((o, i) => <li key={o} className={i === 0 ? `${LI} bg-gray-100` : LI} onMouseDown={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); pickOp(o) }}><span>{o}</span></li>) : none}</ul>
  else if (open && stage.op === 'Contains') menu = <ul className={UL}>{free ? <li className={`${LI} bg-gray-100`} onMouseDown={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); add({ ...stage, value: text.trim() }) }}><span>Contains "{text.trim()}"</span></li> : <li className={LI}><span>Type any text, then press Enter</span></li>}
    {free && valuesShown.slice(0, 8).map((o) => <li key={o} className={LI} onMouseDown={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); add({ ...stage, op: 'Is', value: o }) }}><span>{o}</span></li>)}</ul>
  else if (open) menu = <ul className={UL}>{valuesShown.length ? valuesShown.map((o, i) => <li key={o} className={i === 0 ? `${LI} bg-gray-100` : LI} onMouseDown={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); add({ ...stage, value: o }) }}><span>{o}</span></li>) : none}</ul>

  return (
    <form ref={box} className="relative z-0 flex gap-2 p-2 border-x border-gray-200 responsive-filter" onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); onApply(draft) }}>
      <div className="text-sm rounded-lg border border-gray-300 p-1 focus:ring-indigo-700 text-gray-800 bg-white flex w-full">
        <div className="flex w-full flex-wrap">
          <div className="flex gap-2 flex-wrap flex-grow pr-12">
            {draft.map((c, i) => (
              <div key={i} className="flex">
                <Part><FieldName f={fieldOf(c.field)} /></Part>
                <Part><span>{c.op}</span></Part>
                <Part><div className="flex items-center"><span>{c.value}</span><span className="icon-x text-sm text-gray-400 cursor-pointer hover:bg-error-300 hover:text-error-500" onClick={() => remove(i)} /></div></Part>
              </div>
            ))}
            <div className="rounded-md flex-grow flex">
              {stage && <Part><FieldName f={fieldOf(stage.field)} /></Part>}
              {stage?.op && <Part><span>{stage.op}</span></Part>}
              <div className="w-full">
                <div className="w-full h-full flex items-start">
                  <div className="flex items-center w-full">
                    {!stage && !draft.length && <span className="icon-search-lg text-xl text-gray-400 ms-2 me-1" />}
                    <input type="text" className="w-full 2xl:p-[7px] 2xl-to-xl:p-1 p-1 2xl:text-sm 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs outline-none" placeholder={stage?.op === 'Contains' ? 'Type any text, then press Enter' : stage ? 'Type to find, then pick' : draft.length ? '' : 'Filter Results...'}
                      value={text} onChange={(e) => { setText(e.target.value); setOpen(true) }} onFocus={() => setOpen(true)} onClick={() => setOpen(true)} onKeyDown={onKey} />
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className={menu ? 'transition-opacity duration-500 opacity-100 scale-100' : 'transition-opacity duration-500 scale-0 opacity-0'}>{menu || fieldMenu}</div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="w-8">
          {(draft.length > 0 || stage) && <div className="h-full flex items-center w-full px-1 cursor-pointer" onClick={() => { setDraft([]); setStage(null); setText(''); onApply([]) }}><span className="icon-x-close text-lg hover:bg-red-300 rounded-sm ms-1 hover:text-white" /></div>}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div>
        <button type="submit" className="outline-none font-semibold rounded-lg disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-100 py-2.5 px-4 bg-indigo-50 border border-indigo-200 text-indigo-700 disabled:bg-gray-100 disabled:text-gray-500 disabled:border-gray-400 2xl:text-sm 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs 2xl:min-h-[42px] 2xl-to-xl:min-h-10 min-h-10 flex justify-center items-center">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2">Filter</div>
        </button>
      </div>
    </form>
  )
}

// COPIED: the ⓘ = class string in modules/crm-invoice/dom/goals_tracker.html (14 captures). The dark box = CollabCRM's react-tooltip (445 captures):
// --rt-color-dark #101828 + white text + 3px corners, from _design-system/app-css. Our own part: position fixed, so a card's overflow cannot clip it.
import { useState } from 'react'

export default function InfoTip({ text, className = 'text-base icon-info-circle cursor-pointer text-gray-500', children, wrap = 'relative inline-flex' }) {
  const [at, setAt] = useState(null)
  const show = (e) => { const b = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect(); setAt({ x: Math.min(Math.max(b.left + b.width / 2, 160), window.innerWidth - 160), y: b.top, ax: b.left + b.width / 2 }) }
  return (
    <span className={wrap} onMouseEnter={show} onMouseLeave={() => setAt(null)} onFocus={show} onBlur={() => setAt(null)} tabIndex={0}>
      {children || <span className={className} />}
      {at && (
        <span role="tooltip" style={{ position: 'fixed', left: at.x, top: at.y - 8, transform: 'translate(-50%, -100%)', background: '#101828', color: '#fff', padding: '8px 16px', borderRadius: 3, maxWidth: 296, width: 'max-content', fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 500, lineHeight: '18px', zIndex: 60, whiteSpace: 'normal', textAlign: 'left' }}>
          {text}
          <span style={{ position: 'absolute', bottom: -4, left: `calc(50% + ${at.ax - at.x}px)`, width: 8, height: 8, background: '#101828', transform: 'translateX(-50%) rotate(45deg)' }} />
        </span>
      )}
    </span>
  )
}

function Card({ c, onOpen, onDrag, first, pm }) {
  const a = c.person
  const ppl = c.people || (a ? [a] : [])
  const i = (a?.first_name || '').length % BG.length
  return (
    <div className={pm && first ? 'px-1 pt-0' : 'px-1 pt-1'}>
      <li className="_Wrapper_vful1_21"><div className="_Item_vful1_40">
        <div draggable onDragStart={(e) => { e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', c.id); onDrag() }} onDragEnd={() => onDrag(null)} onClick={onOpen}
          className="relative rounded-[5px] shadow-sm select-none w-full max-w-md group border bg-white hover:bg-blueDark-25 hover:border-indigo-200 cursor-pointer border-gray-200">
          <a className="cursor-pointer"><div className="2xl:p-4 2xl-to-xl:p-3 p-3">
            {c.menu && <div className="absolute top-1 opacity-0 pointer-events-none right-1 bg-white 2xl:size-9 2xl-to-xl:size-7 size-7 rounded-md m-1 flex items-center justify-center shadow-custom-black cursor-pointer group-hover:opacity-100 group-hover:pointer-events-auto"><span className="icon-dots-horizontal text-gray-500 2xl:text-2xl 2xl-to-xl:text-xl text-xl" /></div>}
            <div className="flex items-start gap-1.5">
              {c.icon && <span title={c.iconTitle} className={`${c.icon} text-gray-500 text-sm leading-5 shrink-0`} />}
              <h2 className="2xl:text-sm 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs font-medium w-full text-gray-700 whitespace-break-spaces break-words">{c.title}</h2>
            </div>
            {(c.sub || c.late) && (
              <div className="flex justify-between gap-2 mt-3">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-center text-gray-500 2xl:text-sm 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs font-medium">
                  {c.sub && <><span className={`icon-${c.subIcon || 'building-07'} text-base mx-1.5 cursor-pointer text-gray-500`} title={c.subTitle} /><p className="text-xs text-gray-500" title={c.subTitle || c.sub}>{c.sub}</p></>}
                </div>
                <div className="h-[22px] text-xs flex items-center">{c.late && <span className="text-error-500">{c.late}</span>}</div>
              </div>
            )}
            <div className="mt-3 flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="relative inline-block"><div><div className="flex items-center relative">
                {ppl.length ? ppl.map((p, k) => <Avatar key={k} a={p} i={c.people ? k : i} first={k === 0} />) : <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">Unassigned</p>}
              </div></div></div>
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                {c.priority && <div className="relative inline-block"><div title={`${c.priority[0].toUpperCase() + c.priority.slice(1)} Priority`} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer rounded-md border transition-colors px-1 py-0.5 border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 hover:bg-gray-100 hover:border-gray-300"><span className={PRIO[c.priority]} /></div></div>}
                {c.code && <><span className="text-gray-500 text-xxs pt-[1px] ms-[5px] me-2">|</span>
                  {c.type && <span title={c.type.title} className={`mr-1 2xl:text-base 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs ${c.type.icon}`} />}
                  <div className="text-gray-500 text-xs ml-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-1"><a className={c.done ? 'hover:text-indigo-700 font-medium line-through hover:line-through' : 'hover:text-indigo-700 hover:underline font-medium'}><span className="hover:underline 2xl:text-sm 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs">{c.code}</span></a></div></>}
              </div>
            </div>
            {pm && <div className="overflow-scroll scrollbar-hide transition-[max-height,margin] duration-500 ease-in-out max-h-0" />}
          </div></a>
        </div>
      </div></li>
    </div>
  )
}

export default function Kanban({ columns, rows, colOf = (r) => r.status, card, onOpen, move, allowed = () => true, fit = false, headerActions = false }) {
  const [drag, setDrag] = useState(null)
  const [over, setOver] = useState(null)
  const [more, setMore] = useState({})
  return (
    <div className="w-full overflow-x-auto cursor-default">
      <div className={fit ? 'grid box-border p-2 ps-0 gap-2' : 'inline-grid box-border p-2 ps-0 gap-2 grid-flow-col'} style={fit ? { gridTemplateColumns: `repeat(${columns.length}, minmax(180px, 1fr))` } : undefined}>
        {headerActions && <div id="new-create-issue-list">{/* hidden "add a status column" box, first in the grid (issue_board.html) */}
          <div className="flex flex-col overflow-hidden !outline-none h-full rounded-lg transition-all transform w-0 scale-90 opacity-0 border border-none bg-transparent">
            <div className="bg-white flex items-center gap-2 px-2 py-1 outline-none cursor-default w-full">
              <div className="flex-1 rounded-[4px] px-2 py-1.5 border flex items-center border-gray-200 bg-gray-50">
                <input type="text" className="outline-none flex-1 font-semibold text-gray-900 2xl:!text-base 2xl-to-xl:!text-sm !text-sm bg-gray-50 me-1" max="35" defaultValue="" />
                <div className="relative"><div className="cursor-pointer border border-slate-400 border-none h-6 w-6 rounded-sm" style={{ background: 'rgb(43, 131, 222)' }} /></div>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                <div className="z-1"><span className="icon-x border border-gray-300 rounded-lg bg-white flex items-center justify-center 2xl:text-xl text-lg cursor-pointer text-gray-400 h-6 w-6 !rounded-md" /></div>
                <div className="z-1"><span className="icon-check flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-white 2xl:text-xl text-lg relative bg-indigo-400 cursor-not-allowed h-6 w-6 !rounded-md" /></div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <ul className="bg-gray-200" />
          </div>
        </div>}
        {columns.map(({ key: k, label, color: c }) => {
          const list = rows.filter((r) => colOf(r) === k)
          const ok = drag && colOf(drag) !== k && allowed(drag, k)
          const n = more[k] || PAGE
          return (
            <div key={k}>
              <div onDragOver={(e) => { if (ok) { e.preventDefault(); setOver(k) } }} onDragLeave={() => setOver((o) => (o === k ? null : o))}
                onDrop={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); setOver(null); if (ok) move?.(drag, k); setDrag(null) }}
                style={{ opacity: drag && !ok && colOf(drag) !== k ? 0.5 : 1, outline: over === k ? `2px solid ${c}` : undefined }}
                className={`_Container_1hean_1 _scrollable_1hean_17 flex flex-col overflow-hidden bg-gray-200 !outline-none ${fit ? 'min-w-0' : 'min-w-[362px]'} h-full rounded-lg border border-gray-300`}>
                <div className="bg-white flex items-center justify-between 2xl:px-2 2xl-to-xl:px-1 px-1 2xl:py-1 2xl-to-xl:py-0.5 py-0.5 outline-none cursor-grab">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2"><div className="px-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-1">
                    <div className="2xl:size-2.5 2xl-to-xl:size-2 size-2 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: c }} />
                    <p title={label} className="rounded py-2 px-2 mx-0.5 font-semibold max-w-[200px] truncate text-gray-900 2xl:text-base 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100">{label}</p>
                    <p title={String(list.length)} style={{ color: c, backgroundColor: rgba(c, 0.063), border: `1px solid ${rgba(c, 0.365)}` }} className="2xl:!py-0.5 2xl-to-xl:!py-0 !py-0 px-2 text-center 2xl:!text-xs 2xl-to-xl:!text-xxs !text-xxs w-fit font-semibold rounded-2xl cursor-pointer">{list.length}</p>
                  </div></div>
                  {headerActions && <div className="flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer">
                    <div className="2xl:size-10 2xl-to-xl:size-8 size-8 flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-gray-100 rounded-md transition-all duration-300" title="Create Issue"><span className="icon-plus text-gray-700 text-lg" /></div>
                    <div className="relative" title="Actions"><div className="relative 2xl:size-10 2xl-to-xl:size-8 size-8 flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-gray-100 rounded-md transition-all duration-300"><span className="icon-dots-vertical text-gray-700 text-lg" /></div></div>
                  </div>}
                </div>
                {headerActions && <form className="overflow-hidden bg-gray-200 transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out h-0 opacity-0 scale-90">
                  <div className="w-full bg-white 2xl:p-4 2xl-to-xl:p-3 p-3 rounded-[5px] shadow-lg transform transition-transform duration-200 ease-out">
                    <div className="flex items-center 2xl:mt-4 2xl-to-xl:mt-3 mt-3">
                      <button type="button" className="outline-none disabled:cursor-not-allowed border disabled:opacity-100 hover:opacity-90 mr-2.5 2xl:py-1.5 2xl-to-xl:py-1 py-1 2xl:px-3.5 2xl-to-xl:px-2.5 px-2 2xl:text-sm 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs bg-white border-gray-300 text-gray-700 font-semibold hover:!bg-gray-50 2xl:rounded-lg 2xl-to-xl:rounded-[5px] rounded-[5px]"><div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2">Cancel</div></button>
                      <button type="submit" disabled className="outline-none font-semibold disabled:cursor-not-allowed border disabled:opacity-100 disabled:bg-indigo-200 border-transparent bg-indigo-600 text-white 2xl:py-1.5 2xl-to-xl:py-1 py-1 2xl:px-3.5 2xl-to-xl:px-2.5 px-2 2xl:text-sm 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs 2xl:rounded-lg 2xl-to-xl:rounded-[5px] rounded-[5px]"><div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2">Create</div></button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </form>}
                <ul className="bg-gray-200" style={{ maxHeight: 'calc(100vh - 360px)', minHeight: 120, overflowY: 'auto', paddingBottom: 4 }}>
                  {list.slice(0, n).map((r, x) => { const c2 = card(r); return <Card key={c2.id} c={c2} first={x === 0} pm={headerActions} onOpen={() => onOpen?.(r)} onDrag={(x) => setDrag(x === null ? null : r)} /> })}
                  {list.length > n && <div className="px-1 pt-1"><p className="font-semibold text-xs w-fit text-indigo-700 cursor-pointer hover:text-indigo-800" onClick={() => setMore((m) => ({ ...m, [k]: n + PAGE }))}>Show {Math.min(PAGE, list.length - n)} more of {list.length - n}</p></div>}
                </ul>
              </div>
            </div>
          )
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

=== FILE: src/components/cc/Modal.jsx ===
// COPIED from src/components/ConfirmDialog.jsx (itself copied from modules/project-mgmt/dom/c2_row_action.html):
// same backdrop, centred sm:max-w-lg card, ✕ (with its mb-5), title. Differences, all because the body here is children, not a message:
// no round icon badge; footer = the real Add Ticket drawer footer (`pt-6 flex items-center gap-x-4`, Cancel then Submit, left-aligned).
// Omit `onConfirm` for no footer. Clicking outside the card closes it (the scroll layer sits above the backdrop, so it handles the click).
import { useEffect } from 'react'
import Button from './Button.jsx'

export default function Modal({ title, onClose, children, confirmLabel = 'Submit', cancelLabel = 'Cancel', onConfirm, confirmDisabled }) {
  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') onClose?.() }
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey)
  }, [onClose])
  const outside = (e) => { if (e.target === e.currentTarget) onClose?.() }
  return (
    <div className="relative z-[999]" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label={title}>
      <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-gray-900 opacity-70" />
      <div className="fixed inset-0 overflow-y-auto" onMouseDown={outside}>
        <div className="flex min-h-full items-center justify-center p-4 " onMouseDown={outside}>
          <div className="w-full max-w-full sm:max-w-lg relative">
            <div className="2xl:p-4 2xl-to-xl:p-3 p-3 overflow-hidden border-0 rounded-lg shadow-lg relative flex flex-col w-full bg-white outline-none focus:outline-none">
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                <p className="text-gray-900 font-semibold 2xl:text-lg 2xl-to-xl:text-base text-base pt-1">{title}</p>
                <span className="icon-x-close cursor-pointer text-2xl text-gray-500 mb-5" onClick={onClose} />
              </div>
              <div className="z-10"><div className="relative z-1 mt-4">{children}</div></div>
              {onConfirm && (
                <div className="2xl:pt-8 2xl-to-xl:pt-6 pt-6 flex items-center gap-x-4">
                  <Button variant="white" onClick={onClose}>{cancelLabel}</Button>
                  <Button onClick={onConfirm} disabled={confirmDisabled}>{confirmLabel}</Button>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
