=== FILE: src/components/cc/PillStrip.jsx ===
// COPIED from the "My Tickets / Assigned To Me" strip of modules/people/dom/rsp_tabs_support_ticket_view_01_view_request_2026-09-25.html
// (sliding indigo-600 pill). tabs = [{ key, label }]. The slider's width / offset are inline styles in the real DOM too.
import { useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'

export default function PillStrip({ tabs, active, onChange }) {
  const refs = useRef({})
  const [pos, setPos] = useState({ w: 0, x: 2 })
  // FIX (payroll-calculator, 15 Oct): measure again when the web font arrives or a button resizes, else the pill keeps the
  // fallback-font width and cuts the label ("Predefined Pr…").
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const measure = () => { const b = refs.current[active]; if (b) setPos({ w: b.offsetWidth, x: b.offsetLeft }) }
    measure()
    const ro = typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined' ? new ResizeObserver(measure) : null
    Object.values(refs.current).forEach((el) => el && ro?.observe(el))
    document.fonts?.ready?.then(measure)
    return () => ro?.disconnect()
  }, [active, tabs.length])
  return (
    <div className="z-0 flex gap-1 text-sm bg-gray-50 2xl:p-1 2xl-to-xl:p-0.5 p-0.5 2xl-to-xl:px-1 px-1 border border-gray-200 relative overflow-hidden rounded-full">
      <div className="absolute left-0 bg-indigo-600 z-0 transition-transform duration-300 ease-ease rounded-full top-[2px] h-[calc(100%-4px)]" style={{ width: pos.w, transform: `translateX(${pos.x}px)` }} />
      {tabs.map((t) => (
        <button key={t.key} ref={(el) => { refs.current[t.key] = el }} type="button" onClick={() => onChange?.(t.key)}
          className={t.key === active
            ? 'block font-medium transition-colors ease-in-out z-1 2xl:text-sm 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs rounded-full text-white 2xl:py-1 2xl-to-xl:py-1.5 py-1.5 px-3'
            : 'block font-medium transition-colors z-1 2xl:text-sm 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs rounded-full 2xl:py-1 2xl-to-xl:py-1.5 py-1.5 px-3'}>
          {t.label}
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}

=== FILE: src/components/cc/RichText.jsx ===
// COPIED: the Description editor of PM › Create Issue (modules/project-mgmt/dom/yop_create_issue_form_empty_2026-10-07.html): rte-host › rte-outer ›
// rte-wrapper › rte-toolbar (its buttons and SVG icons pasted verbatim, ./rte-toolbar.html) › rte-editor-area › ".tiptap ProseMirror".
// Styles = the app's own editor CSS (_design-system/rte-editor.css → src/styles/rte-editor.css). BA 8 Oct (#18).
// DIVERGES: the real editor is Tiptap; here the same markup is a contentEditable box and the buttons call the browser's formatting commands
// (bold, italic, underline, strike, clear, align, lists, indent, code block, quote, divider). Heading, colours, link, table, emoji, voice and
// fullscreen are shown but do nothing (no new library, CLAUDE.md rule 6).
import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
import TOOLBAR from './rte-toolbar.html?raw'
import '../../styles/rte-editor.css'

const CMD = {
  'Bold (Ctrl+B)': ['bold'], 'Italic (Ctrl+I)': ['italic'], 'Underline (Ctrl+U)': ['underline'], 'Strikethrough': ['strikeThrough'], 'Clear formatting': ['removeFormat'],
  'Align left': ['justifyLeft'], 'Align center': ['justifyCenter'], 'Align right': ['justifyRight'], 'Ordered list': ['insertOrderedList'], 'Bullet list': ['insertUnorderedList'],
  'Decrease indent': ['outdent'], 'Increase indent': ['indent'], 'Code block': ['formatBlock', 'pre'], 'Blockquote': ['formatBlock', 'blockquote'], 'Insert Divider': ['insertHorizontalRule'],
}
const esc = (x) => x.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
export const textToHtml = (t) => (t || '').split('\n').map((l) => `<p>${esc(l) || '<br>'}</p>`).join('')

/** html = starting content (read once); onChange({ html, text }) on every edit */
export default function RichText({ html, onChange }) {
  const ed = useRef(null)
  useEffect(() => { if (ed.current) ed.current.innerHTML = html || '<p><br></p>' }, [])   // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  const emit = () => onChange?.({ html: ed.current.innerHTML, text: ed.current.innerText.replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n').trim() })
  const run = (e) => {
    const b = e.target.closest('button'); if (!b) return
    e.preventDefault()                                   // keep the text selection in the editor
    const c = CMD[b.title]; if (!c) return
    ed.current.focus(); document.execCommand(c[0], false, c[1]); emit()
  }
  return (
    <div className="rte-host"><div className="rte-host"><div className="w-full relative rte-outer">
      <div className="rte-wrapper border-gray-300 m-0 [&_.ProseMirror]:min-h-[300px] relative">
        <div className="rte-toolbar" onMouseDown={run} dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: TOOLBAR }} />
        <div className="rte-editor-area"><div className="rte-editor-content-wrapper">
          <div ref={ed} contentEditable suppressContentEditableWarning role="textbox" translate="no" className="tiptap ProseMirror" tabIndex={0} onInput={emit} />
        </div></div>
      </div>
    </div></div></div>
  )
}

      <div className="flex flex-col">{children}</div>
    </div>
  )
  return span ? <div className={span === 2 ? 'lg:col-span-2' : 'xl:col-span-2'}>{card}</div> : card
}
export const Pad = ({ children }) => <div className="2xl:p-4 2xl-to-xl:p-3 p-3">{children}</div>

export function NoData({ text = 'No Data Available' }) {
  return (
    <div className="h-full flex items-center flex-col"><div className="h-full text-base font-medium text-gray-900 flex flex-col items-center justify-center">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center relative"><div className="p-8 rounded-full bg-gray-100"><span className="icon-clipboard-x flex items-center justify-center text-[40px] text-gray-500" /></div></div>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center flex-col"><p className="pb-6 pt-5 text-gray-900 font-semibold 2xl:text-sm 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs z-[1]"><span className="text-sm text-gray-600 font-normal">{text}</span></p></div>
    </div></div>
  )
}

const TH = '2xl:py-3 2xl-to-xl:py-1.5 py-1.5 2xl:px-6 2xl-to-xl:px-4 px-4 whitespace-nowrap 2xl:text-sm 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs font-medium text-gray-600 text-left bg-gray-50 sticky top-0'
const TD = 'whitespace-nowrap 2xl:text-sm 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs text-gray-600 text-left 2xl:py-3 2xl-to-xl:py-1.5 py-1.5 2xl:px-6 2xl-to-xl:px-4 px-4'
// sort (BA 6 Oct: "sort by clicking the column, like every CollabCRM list"): heads may be { label, key }; sort = { key, desc }; onSort(key).
// The header markup is the Help Center list's real sortable <th> (cc/DataTable): label + `text-gray-300 text-base icon-sort ml-1`;
// the sorted column shows its direction with the real `icon-arrow-narrow-down` / `-up` in gray-600 (icon-sort-down has no glyph in the
// icon font). DIVERGES: the arrow + gray-600 on the sorted column.
export function WidgetTable({ heads, rows, onRow, empty, max = 'max-h-[370px]', numbered = true, sort, onSort }) {
  if (!rows.length) return <NoData text={empty} />
  const head = (h) => {
    if (!h || typeof h !== 'object' || !h.key) return h
    const on = sort?.key === h.key
    return (
      <div className="flex">
        <span className="self-center">{h.label}</span>
        <div className="flex items-center"><span className={`${on ? 'text-gray-600' : 'text-gray-300'} text-base ${on ? (sort.desc ? 'icon-arrow-narrow-down' : 'icon-arrow-narrow-up') : 'icon-sort'} ml-1`} /></div>
      </div>
    )
  }
  return (
    <div className="inline-block w-full align-middle"><div className={`overflow-auto ${max}`}>
      <table className="min-w-full divide-y divide-gray-200 bg-gray-200 tableSticky">
        <thead><tr>{numbered && <th className={`${TH} w-[1%]`}>No.</th>}{heads.map((h, i) => <th key={i} className={`${TH}${h?.key ? ' cursor-pointer' : ''}`} onClick={h?.key ? () => onSort?.(h.key) : undefined}>{head(h)}</th>)}</tr></thead>
        <tbody className="divide-y divide-[#EAEAEA] bg-white">
          {rows.map((r, i) => (
            <tr key={i} className="h-[65px] hover:bg-gray-50 group" onClick={onRow ? () => onRow(i) : undefined} style={onRow ? { cursor: 'pointer' } : undefined}>
              {numbered && <td className={TD}><p className="text-gray-600 max-w-[160px] truncate font-medium line-clamp-1">{i + 1}</p></td>}
              {r.map((c, j) => <td key={j} className={TD}>{j === 0 ? <span className=" font-medium"><p className="max-w-56 w-fit truncate">{c}</p></span> : <div className="max-w-56 truncate">{c}</div>}</td>)}
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div></div>
  )
}
// a number that opens a drill-down / link
export const Num = ({ children, onClick, color }) => <a className={`${T} text-indigo-700 font-semibold`} style={color ? { color } : undefined} onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); onClick?.() }}>{children}</a>
export const Legend = ({ items, flat }) => (
  <ul className={flat ? 'flex justify-end space-x-4' : 'flex justify-end space-x-4 mb-8'}>
    {items.map(([label, color]) => <li key={label} className="flex items-center"><span className="w-2 h-2 block rounded-full mr-1" style={{ backgroundColor: color }} /><span className="text-xs text-slate-600">{label}</span></li>)}
  </ul>
)

// DIVERGES: PROTOTYPE ONLY — not a CollabCRM control, so there is no real string to copy. Made general from
// prototypes/helpdesk-ticketing/src/role.jsx (RoleSwitch). Dashed border = "not part of the product".
// Goes in the shell's topRight slot only (kit rule 4):  <AppShell topRight={<DemoMenu />}>  ·  <SuperShell topRight={<DemoMenu />}>
// Menu: "Viewing as" grouped by side · open a person in a new tab (?as=) · Show notes · Reset demo data.
// Inner pieces reuse kit components: Toggle (cc/Toggle.jsx) and askConfirm (ConfirmDialog.jsx).
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'
import { askConfirm } from '../ConfirmDialog.jsx'
import Toggle from '../cc/Toggle.jsx'
import { demoConfig, fullName, resetDemo, setNotes, setViewer, tabPinned, useNotes, useViewer } from './demo.js'

export default function DemoMenu() {
  const me = useViewer(); const notes = useNotes(); const nav = useNavigate()
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false); const box = useRef(null)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return
    const out = (e) => { if (box.current && !box.current.contains(e.target)) setOpen(false) }
    const esc = (e) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') setOpen(false) }
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', out, true); document.addEventListener('keydown', esc)
    return () => { document.removeEventListener('mousedown', out, true); document.removeEventListener('keydown', esc) }
  }, [open])
  if (!me) return null
  const { sides, resetMessage } = demoConfig()
  const pick = (u) => { setOpen(false); setViewer(u.as); nav(u.home) }
  const newTab = (u) => window.open(`/?as=${encodeURIComponent(u.as)}`, '_blank')
  const reset = async () => {
    setOpen(false)
    if (await askConfirm({ title: 'Reset demo data?', message: resetMessage || 'Everything goes back to the starting demo data, in every open tab.', confirmLabel: 'Reset', cancelLabel: 'Keep' })) resetDemo()
  }
  return (
    <div ref={box} className="relative">
      <button type="button" onClick={() => setOpen((v) => !v)} aria-haspopup="menu" aria-expanded={open}
        className={`inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-dashed 2xl:h-10 2xl-to-xl:h-8 h-8 pl-1.5 pr-2.5 2xl:text-sm 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs ${open ? 'border-indigo-400 bg-indigo-50' : 'border-gray-300 bg-white hover:border-gray-400'}`}>
        <span className="rounded bg-amber-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-amber-700">Demo</span>
        <span className="text-gray-500">Viewing as</span>
        <span className="font-semibold text-gray-900">{me.label}</span>
        {notes && <span title="Notes are on" className="size-1.5 rounded-full bg-indigo-600" />}
        <span className={`icon-chevron-down text-gray-500 transition-transform ${open ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`} />
      </button>
      {open && (
        <div role="menu" className="absolute right-0 top-full z-[80] mt-2 w-80 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-white py-2 shadow-lg 2xl:text-sm 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs">
          <p className="px-4 pb-2 text-gray-500">Prototype only — switch whose screens you see. In CollabCRM these are separate logins.</p>
          {sides.map((s, i) => (
            <div key={s.side}>
              <div className={`flex items-center justify-between px-4 pb-1 ${i ? 'mt-2 border-t border-gray-100 pt-3' : 'pt-1'}`}>
                <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-gray-400">{s.side}</span>
                {s.note && <span className="text-[11px] text-gray-400">{s.note}</span>}
              </div>
              {s.users.map((u) => {
                const on = u.as === me.as
                return (
                  <div key={u.as} className={`group flex items-center gap-1 pr-2 ${on ? 'bg-indigo-50' : 'hover:bg-gray-50'}`}>
                    <button type="button" role="menuitemradio" aria-checked={on} onClick={() => pick(u)} className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-3 py-2 pl-4 text-left">
                      <span className={`icon-check w-4 shrink-0 ${on ? 'text-indigo-600' : 'invisible'}`} />
                      <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                        <span className={`block truncate font-medium ${on ? 'text-indigo-700' : 'text-gray-900'}`}>{fullName(u.person)}</span>
                        <span className="block text-gray-500">{u.label}</span>
                      </span>
                    </button>
                    <button type="button" onClick={() => newTab(u)} title={`Open ${fullName(u.person)} in a new tab (side by side)`}
                      className="shrink-0 rounded-md p-1.5 text-gray-400 opacity-0 hover:bg-gray-100 hover:text-gray-700 focus:opacity-100 group-hover:opacity-100">
                      <span className="icon-link-external-02" />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                )
              })}
            </div>
          ))}
          <div className="mt-2 border-t border-gray-100 pt-2">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-2">
              <span>
                <span className="block font-medium text-gray-900">Show notes</span>
                <span className="block text-gray-500">Numbered pins explaining each screen</span>
              </span>
              <Toggle id="demo-notes" checked={notes} onChange={setNotes} />
            </div>
            <button type="button" onClick={reset} className="flex w-full items-center gap-3 px-4 py-2 text-left text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50">
              <span className="icon-refresh-cw-05" /> Reset demo data
            </button>
          </div>
          {tabPinned() && <p className="px-4 pt-2 text-[11px] text-gray-400">This tab was opened for one person (?as=); switching here changes only this tab.</p>}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

// DIVERGES: PROTOTYPE ONLY — never part of CollabCRM. Copied from prototypes/helpdesk-ticketing/src/components/Pin.jsx.
// A numbered pin beside an element while "Show notes" is on (Demo menu); click = its note. Off by default.
// The ONLY place BA notes may appear inside a prototype (brief v2, Rule 6). Notes live in DEMO.notes (src/data/demo.js):
//   notes: { E2: [{ title, source, rule, edge, real }] }   →   <Pin s="E2" n={1} />   (n is 1-based)
// Pin = the real count-pill string (indigo-200 / 50 / 700); the note panel is an inline-styled layer (no CollabCRM class pretends
// to be it) whose text uses the real record-panel label / value strings.
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom'
import { demoConfig, useNotes } from './demo.js'

const ROWS = [['source', 'Source'], ['rule', 'Rule'], ['edge', 'Edge cases'], ['real', 'Real or new']]

export default function Pin({ s, n }) {
  const on = useNotes()
  const [box, setBox] = useState(null)
  const ref = useRef(null)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!box) return
    const close = (e) => { if (!e.target.closest?.('[data-note-panel]') && !ref.current?.contains(e.target)) setBox(null) }
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', close, true); return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', close, true)
  }, [box])
  const note = demoConfig().notes?.[s]?.[n - 1]
  if (!on || !note) return null
  const open = (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation(); e.preventDefault()
    const r = ref.current.getBoundingClientRect(); const w = 360
    setBox(box ? null : { left: Math.max(8, Math.min(r.left, window.innerWidth - w - 8)), top: r.bottom + 6 > window.innerHeight - 260 ? undefined : r.bottom + 6, bottom: r.bottom + 6 > window.innerHeight - 260 ? window.innerHeight - r.top + 6 : undefined, width: w })
  }
  return (
    <span ref={ref} onClick={open} title={`Note ${s}·${n}: ${note.title}`} style={{ display: 'inline-flex', verticalAlign: 'middle', margin: '0 4px', cursor: 'pointer', zIndex: 5, position: 'relative' }}>
      <span className="rounded-2xl border flex w-max font-medium items-center border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 2xl:!text-xs 2xl-to-xl:!text-xxs !text-xxs 2xl:!py-0.5 2xl-to-xl:!py-0 !py-0 py-0.5 px-2 text-xs">{s}·{n}</span>
      {box && createPortal(
        <div data-note-panel style={{ position: 'fixed', zIndex: 2000, ...box, background: '#fff', border: '1px solid #c7d7fe', borderRadius: 8, boxShadow: '0 10px 30px rgba(16,24,40,.18)', padding: 12, maxHeight: 420, overflowY: 'auto' }}>
          <p className="2xl:text-sm 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs font-medium text-gray-900">{s} · {n}. {note.title}</p>
          {ROWS.map(([key, label]) => note[key] && (
            <div key={key}>
              <p className="text-[10px] 2xl:text-xs 2xl-to-xl:text-xxs text-gray-400 pt-4">{label}</p>
              <p className="text-gray-800 2xl:text-sm 2xl-to-xl:text-xs text-xs">{note[key]}</p>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>, document.body)}
    </span>
  )
}


=== FILE: src/components/demo/demo.js ===
// PROTOTYPE ONLY — not part of CollabCRM. The state behind the Demo menu: who this tab is "viewing as", and Show notes on/off.
// Made general from prototypes/helpdesk-ticketing/src/role.jsx (BA team brief v2 §7, 8 Oct).
//
// Each prototype describes its own people in src/data/demo.js and calls initDemo(DEMO) once in main.jsx, before rendering.
//   DEMO = {
//     id: 'leave-approval',                       // storage key, one per prototype
//     sides: [                                    // groups in the menu (e.g. customer side / support side)
//       { side: 'Customer side', note: 'staging-app', users: [
//         { as: 'employee', role: 'employee', label: 'Employee', person: { first_name, last_name }, home: '/people/<tenant>/…' },
//       ] },
//     ],
//     notes: { E1: [{ title, source, rule, edge, real }] },   // Show notes pins: <Pin s="E1" n={1} />
//     resetMessage: 'Everything goes back to the starting demo data, in every open tab.',
//     onReset: () => {},                          // the prototype's own data reset
//   }
// `as` is unique per person (employee, employee-2, manager …). `role` is what screens check (several people can share one role).
// The user types here = the sections of docs/ba/07-user-stories.md = the lanes of docs/ba/06-flow.md, one to one.
//
// ?as=<as> opens a tab pinned to one person (sessionStorage), so two people can sit side by side.
// A tab opened without ?as= shares one choice with the other unpinned tabs (localStorage).
import { useSyncExternalStore } from 'react'

let CFG = { id: 'demo', sides: [], notes: {}, resetMessage: '', onReset: () => {} }
let viewerAs = null
let notesOn = false
const subs = new Set()
const emit = () => subs.forEach((f) => f())
const sub = (f) => (subs.add(f), () => subs.delete(f))
const ss = (() => { try { return window.sessionStorage } catch { return null } })()
const ls = (() => { try { return window.localStorage } catch { return null } })()
const k = (name) => `${CFG.id}_${name}`

export const tabPinned = () => { try { return ss?.getItem(k('tab')) === '1' } catch { return false } }
const get = (name, d) => { try { return (tabPinned() ? ss.getItem(k(name)) ?? ls.getItem(k(name)) : ls.getItem(k(name))) ?? d } catch { return d } }
const put = (name, v) => { try { (tabPinned() ? ss : ls).setItem(k(name), v) } catch { /* no storage: keep in memory only */ } }

export const allUsers = () => CFG.sides.flatMap((s) => s.users)
export const demoConfig = () => CFG
export const fullName = (p) => [p?.first_name, p?.last_name].filter(Boolean).join(' ')

export function initDemo(config) {
  CFG = { ...CFG, ...config }
  const users = allUsers()
  try {
    const u = new URL(window.location.href); const as = u.searchParams.get('as')
    const hit = users.find((x) => x.as === as)
    if (hit) {
      ss.setItem(k('tab'), '1'); ss.setItem(k('viewer'), hit.as)
      u.searchParams.delete('as')
      window.history.replaceState(null, '', (u.pathname === '/' ? hit.home : u.pathname) + (u.search || ''))
    }
  } catch { /* no storage → shared behaviour */ }
  viewerAs = get('viewer', users[0]?.as)
  if (!users.some((x) => x.as === viewerAs)) viewerAs = users[0]?.as
  notesOn = get('notes', '0') === '1'
}

export function setViewer(as) { viewerAs = as; put('viewer', as); emit() }
export function useViewer() {
  const as = useSyncExternalStore(sub, () => viewerAs)
  const u = allUsers().find((x) => x.as === as) || allUsers()[0]
  return u ? { ...u, role: u.role || u.as } : null
}

export function setNotes(on) { notesOn = on; put('notes', on ? '1' : '0'); emit() }
export function useNotes() { return useSyncExternalStore(sub, () => notesOn) }

export function resetDemo() { try { CFG.onReset?.() } finally { emit() } }
